Somali: Fikradda beeraha caqliga leh ee cimilada (CSA) waxay muujineysaa himilo lagu wanaajinayo isdhexgalka horumarinta beeraha iyo jawaab celinta cimilada.

English: The community outreach agenda includes farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS), county agricultural extension offices offering free soil testing advice, and the National Cereals and Produce Board's grain purchase programme for maize farmers.

English: This week's public notice concerns farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS).

English: Residents seeking support can look into the National Agricultural and Rural Inclusive Growth Project (NARIGP) supporting farmer groups or grain storage through the Warehouse Receipt System to reduce post-harvest losses.

Somali: Deganeyaasha taageero raadsada waxay eegi karaan Mashruuca Kobaca Beeraha ee Qaranka iyo Reer Miyiga (NARIGP) ee taageeraya kooxaha beeralayda ama kaydinta badarka iyadoo loo marayo Habka Qasnadda Kaydka Warehouse si loo yareeyo khasaaraha goosashada ka dib.

English: This month's public update covers the fertiliser e-Voucher subsidy programme through NCPB depots, livestock vaccination campaigns against Foot-and-Mouth Disease run by county veterinary offices, and the Kenya Climate-Smart Agriculture Project (KCSAP) promoting drought-resilient farming.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha mpango wa ruzuku ya mbolea wa e-Voucher kupitia maghala ya NCPB, kampeni za chanjo za mifugo dhidi ya ugonjwa wa miguu na midomo zinazoendeshwa na ofisi za mifugo za kaunti, na mradi wa KCSAP unaohamasisha kilimo kinachostahimili ukame.

Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa barnaamijka kabida e-Vucher bacriminta iyada oo loo marayo kaydka NCPB, ololayaasha talaalka xoolaha ee ka dhanka ah Cudurada Foot-iyo-Mouth ee ay maamulaan xafiisyada caafimaadka xoolaha ee gobolka, iyo Mashruuca Beeraha ee Cimilada-Smart ee Kenya (KCSAP) oo kor u qaadaya beerashada abaarta u adkeysanaysa.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund supporting coffee farmers, surveillance and reporting of fall armyworm outbreaks to agricultural officers, and livestock insurance schemes protecting pastoralist households against drought losses.

Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich mar ndiko nying' jopur e chenro mar ng'eyo weche mag pur mag piny Kenya (KIAMIS), opis mag gwenge ma chiwo paro ma nono mag temo lowo, kod chenro mar nyieo cham mag pinyno ne jopur mag cham.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada diiwaan gelinta beeralayda ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Beeraha Isku-dhafan ee Kenya (KIAMIS), xafiisyada fidinta beeraha ee kowntiga oo bixiya talooyinka tijaabinta ciidda lacag-la'aanta ah, iyo barnaamijka guddiga qaran ee firileyda iyo soosaarka gallayda ee beeralayda.

English: Residents seeking support can look into county agricultural extension offices offering free soil testing advice or livestock insurance schemes protecting pastoralist households against drought losses.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaotafuta usaidizi wanaweza kuangalia ofisi za ugani za kilimo za kaunti zinazotoa ushauri wa bure wa upimaji wa udongo au mipango ya bima ya mifugo inayolinda kaya za wafugaji dhidi ya hasara za ukame.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dwaro kony nyalo ng'iyo ofise mag ng'ado pur mag kaunti ma chiwo paro ma nono mar timo tem mag lowo kata chenro mag insurans mag le ma rito udi ma nigi le mondo kik giyud ketho mag oro.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee taageerada raadinaya waxay eegi karaan xafiisyada fidinta beeraha ee gobolka oo bixiya talo baadhis ciidda lacag la'aan ah ama qorshayaasha caymiska xoolaha ee ka ilaalinaya qoysaska xoolo-dhaqatada ah khasaaraha abaarta.

English: Farmers growing groundnuts are advised to watch out for maize streak virus this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima karanga washauriwa kuchunga virusi vya mistari ya mahindi msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho njugu mag lo ochiw rieko mar rito midhusi mar ngano e kindeni.
Somali: Beeraleyda beera lawska waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay ka taxadaraan fayraska xariijimaha galleyda xilli ciyaareedkan.

English: Keep your pigs healthy by monitoring for signs of mastitis.
Kiswahili: Weka nguruwe wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za maambukizi ya kiwele.
Dholuo: Ket anguro mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuo mar lak.
Somali: Ku ilaali doofaarradaada kuwo caafimaad qaba adigoo la socda calaamadaha naasaha.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: extension advice from Kenya Agricultural and Livestock Research Organization (KALRO) officers, the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund supporting coffee farmers, and surveillance and reporting of fall armyworm outbreaks to agricultural officers.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: ushauri wa ugani kutoka kwa maafisa wa KALRO, Mfuko wa Coffee Cherry Advance unaosaidia wakulima wa kahawa, na ufuatiliaji na uripoti wa milipuko ya funza jeshi kwa maafisa wa kilimo.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: rieko mar lando wach kowuok kuom apisas mag Riwruok mar Kenya mar Nonro mar Pur kod Le (KALRO), pesa ma konyo jopur mag kahawa, kod ng'iyo kendo chiwo ripot kuom tuoche mag ng'anjo mag ng'anjo ne apisas mag pur.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa ay xasuusinayaan saddex barnaamij oo socda: Talo-kordhinta Hay'adda Cilmi-baadhista Beeraha iyo Xoolaha ee Kenya (KALRO), Sanduuqa Horumarinta Kafeega ee Horumarinta Kafeega ee taageeraya beeralayda kafeega, iyo kormeerka iyo ka warbixinta faafitaanka gooryaanka ciidanka ee saraakiisha beeraha.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on the Kenya Climate-Smart Agriculture Project (KCSAP) promoting drought-resilient farming, surveillance and reporting of fall armyworm outbreaks to agricultural officers, and the National Cereals and Produce Board's grain purchase programme for maize farmers.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mradi wa KCSAP unaohamasisha kilimo kinachostahimili ukame, ufuatiliaji na uripoti wa milipuko ya funza jeshi kwa maafisa wa kilimo, na mpango wa NCPB wa ununuzi wa nafaka kwa wakulima wa mahindi.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso tich matek e wi chenro mar pur ma rito piny (KCSAP) ma kelo pur ma nyalo geng'o oro, ng'iyo kendo chiwo ripot kuom tuoche mag ng'ich ma nyalo kelo ng'ich ne apisas mag pur, kod chenro mar ng'iewo cham mag cham mag piny Kenya.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada Mashruuca Beeraha ee Cimilada-Smart ee Kenya (KCSAP) ee kor u qaadaya beerashada abaarta u adkeysata, la socodka iyo ka warbixinta cudurrada dayrta ee dirxiga ee saraakiisha beeraha, iyo barnaamijka soo-iibsiga hadhuudhka ee guddiga wax soo saarka ee Qaranka ee beeralayda galleyda.

English: Local radio stations have been asked to air updates on the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund supporting coffee farmers.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya redio vya eneo vimeombwa kutangaza taarifa kuhusu Mfuko wa Coffee Cherry Advance unaosaidia wakulima wa kahawa.
Dholuo: Okwayo stesen mag radio mag alwora mondo ogol weche ma nyasani kuom pesa ma itiyogo e ng'iewo kahawa ma konyo jopur mag kahawa.
Somali: Idaacadaha maxaliga ah ayaa la waydiistay inay hawada ka siidaayaan wararka ku saabsan Sanduuqa Horumarinta Kafeega Cherry ee taageeraya beeralayda kafeega.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the fertiliser e-Voucher subsidy programme through NCPB depots, farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS), and grain storage through the Warehouse Receipt System to reduce post-harvest losses.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia mpango wa ruzuku ya mbolea wa e-Voucher kupitia maghala ya NCPB, usajili wa wakulima kwenye mfumo wa KIAMIS, na uhifadhi wa nafaka kupitia mfumo wa Warehouse Receipt kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen nyiso chenro mar chiwo kony mar e-Voucher mar lum kokalo kuom depot mag NCPB, ndiko nying' jopur e sistem mar ng'eyo weche mag pur mag Kenya (KIAMIS), kod kano cham kokalo kuom sistem mar yudo cham e depo mondo ogeng' ketho ma ng'ato yudo bang' ng'ado cham.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni waxa uu iftiiminayaa barnaamijka kabidda e-Vucher bacriminta iyada oo loo marayo kaydka NCPB, diiwaangelinta beeralayda ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Isku-dhafka Beeraha ee Kenya (KIAMIS), iyo kaydinta hadhuudhka iyada oo loo marayo Habka Kaydka Bakhaarka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dambeeya goosashada.

English: In addition to the National Agricultural and Rural Inclusive Growth Project (NARIGP) supporting farmer groups, residents can also benefit from grain storage through the Warehouse Receipt System to reduce post-harvest losses.
Kiswahili: Mbali na mradi wa NARIGP unaosaidia vikundi vya wakulima, wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na uhifadhi wa nafaka kupitia mfumo wa Warehouse Receipt kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chenro mar dongruok mar piny mangima mar pur kod gwenge (NARIGP) ma konyo grup mag jopur, jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom kano cham kokalo kuom chenro mar yudo cham e dero mondo ogeng' gik ma nyalo kethore bang' ng'ado cham.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago Mashruuca Kobaca Beeraha ee Qaranka iyo Reer Miyiga (NARIGP) ee taageeraya kooxaha beeralayda, dadka deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale ka faa'iidaysan kara kaydinta hadhuudhka iyada oo loo marayo Nidaamka Qasnadda Kaydka Bakhaarka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha goosashada ka dib.

English: Officials are urging the public to consider the fertiliser e-Voucher subsidy programme through NCPB depots alongside grain storage through the Warehouse Receipt System to reduce post-harvest losses.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza umma kuzingatia mpango wa ruzuku ya mbolea wa e-Voucher kupitia maghala ya NCPB pamoja na uhifadhi wa nafaka kupitia mfumo wa Warehouse Receipt kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno.
Dholuo: Jotelo dwaro ni oganda opar matut kuom chenro mar chiwo kony mar e-Voucher mar lum kokalo kuom depot mag NCPB kaachiel gi kano cham kokalo kuom sistem mar yudo cham e dero mondo ogeng' ketho ma ng'ato yudo bang' ng'ado cham.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku boorinayaan dadweynaha inay tixgeliyaan barnaamijka kabidda e-Vucher bacriminta iyada oo loo marayo bakhaarrada NCPB oo ay weheliso kaydinta hadhuudhka iyada oo loo marayo Nidaamka Qaadashada Warehouse si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dambeeya goosashada.

English: Kenya launches a nationwide livestock vaccination program to combat diseases like foot-and-mouth disease, enhancing animal health and meat exports.
Kiswahili: Kenya yazindua mpango wa chanjo ya mifugo kitaifa ili kupambana na magonjwa kama vile ugonjwa wa miguu na midomo, na kuimarisha afya ya wanyama na usafirishaji wa nyama nje ya nchi.
Dholuo: Kenya chako chenro mar kano dhok e piny mangima mondo otiek tuoche kaka midekre mag dho dho dhano, kendo mondo okony le kod ring'o ma ouso e pinje mamoko obed gi ngima maber.

English: Households are advised to keep updated on the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund supporting coffee farmers.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinashauriwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu Mfuko wa Coffee Cherry Advance unaosaidia wakulima wa kahawa.
Dholuo: Jo ot opuonjore mondo gibed gi ng'eyo matut kuom pesa ma itiyogo e ng'iewo kahawa ma konyo jopur mag kahawa.

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: county agricultural extension offices offering free soil testing advice and livestock insurance schemes protecting pastoralist households against drought losses.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: ofisi za ugani za kilimo za kaunti zinazotoa ushauri wa bure wa upimaji wa udongo na mipango ya bima ya mifugo inayolinda kaya za wafugaji dhidi ya hasara za ukame.

English: Access to healthy foods: Improve access to affordable, nutritious food through community gardens, farmers' markets, and food assistance programmes. iii.

Somali: Barnaamij wada jir ah oo wada jir ah ayaa daboolaya labadaba barnaamijka kabidda e-Vucher bacriminta iyada oo loo marayo bakhaarrada NCPB iyo Mashruuca Kobaca Beeraha ee Qaranka iyo Miyiga (NARIGP) ee taageeraya kooxaha beeralayda xilli ciyaareedkan.

English: Officials are urging the public to consider farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS) alongside county agricultural extension offices offering free soil testing advice.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza umma kuzingatia usajili wa wakulima kwenye mfumo wa KIAMIS pamoja na ofisi za ugani za kilimo za kaunti zinazotoa ushauri wa bure wa upimaji wa udongo.
Dholuo: Jotelo dwaro ni oganda opar matut kuom ndiko nying' jopur e sistem mar ng'eyo weche mag pur mag Kenya (KIAMIS) kaachiel gi ofise mag ng'ado bura mag kaunti ma chiwo paro ma onge chudo mar timo nonro mar lowo.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku boorinayaan dadweynaha inay tixgeliyaan diiwaan gelinta beeralayda ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Beeraha Isku-dhafka ah ee Kenya (KIAMIS) oo ay weheliyaan xafiisyada fidinta beeraha ee kowntiga oo bixiya talooyinka baaritaanka ciidda lacag la'aan ah.

English: Households can benefit from either farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS) or surveillance and reporting of fall armyworm outbreaks to agricultural officers, depending on eligibility.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na usajili wa wakulima kwenye mfumo wa KIAMIS au ufuatiliaji na uripoti wa milipuko ya funza jeshi kwa maafisa wa kilimo, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom ndiko nying' jopur e sistem mar ng'eyo weche mag pur (KIAMIS) kata ng'iyo kendo chiwo ripot kuom tuoche mag ng'ado bura ne apisas mag pur, kaluwore gi ng'at ma owinjore.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan diiwaan-gelinta beeralayda ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Beeraha Isku-dhafka ah ee Kenya (KIAMIS) ama ilaalinta iyo ka warbixinta dillaaca gooryaanka ciidanka ee saraakiisha beeraha, iyadoo ku xiran u-qalmitaanka.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights farmer registration on the Kenya Integrated Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS), grain storage through the Warehouse Receipt System to reduce post-harvest losses, and livestock insurance schemes protecting pastoralist households against drought losses.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia usajili wa wakulima kwenye mfumo wa KIAMIS, uhifadhi wa nafaka kupitia mfumo wa Warehouse Receipt kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno, na mipango ya bima ya mifugo inayolinda kaya za wafugaji dhidi ya hasara za ukame.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen nyiso ndiko nying' jopur e sistem mar ng'eyo weche mag pur mag Kenya (KIAMIS), kano cham kokalo kuom sistem mar yudo weche mag cham mondo ogeng' ketho ma bang' ng'ado cham, kod chenro mag insurans mar le ma rito udi ma jokwath mondo kik giyud ketho mag oro.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni waxa uu muujinayaa diiwaangelinta beeralayda ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Beeraha Isku-dhafan ee Kenya (KIAMIS), kaydinta hadhuudhka iyada oo loo marayo Nidaamka Kaydka Bakhaarka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dambeeya goosashada, iyo qorshayaasha caymiska xoolaha ee ka ilaalinaya qoysaska xoolo-dhaqatada ah khasaaraha abaarta.

English: This month's public update covers livestock vaccination campaigns against Foot-and-Mouth Disease run by county veterinary offices, county agricultural extension offices offering free soil testing advice, and the National Cereals and Produce Board's grain purchase programme for maize farmers.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha kampeni za chanjo za mifugo dhidi ya ugonjwa wa miguu na midomo zinazoendeshwa na ofisi za mifugo za kaunti, ofisi za ugani za kilimo za kaunti zinazotoa ushauri wa bure wa upimaji wa udongo, na mpango wa NCPB wa ununuzi wa nafaka kwa wakulima wa mahindi.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni ji duto oting'o kampen mag chiwo chanjo ne le ma geng'o tuo mar tielo kod dhok ma itimo gi apis mag thieth mag le mag kaunti, apis mag lando pur mag kaunti machiwo paro maonge chudo mag temo lowo, kod chenro mar nyieo cham mag Bod mar Pinyruoth mar Nyieo Cham mag cham ne jopur mag cham.
Somali: Warka dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa uu quseeyaa ololaha talaalka xoolaha ee lagaga hortagayo xanuunka cagaha iyo afka ee ay maamulaan xafiisyada caafimaadka xoolaha ee gobolka, xafiisyada fidinta beeraha ee degmada oo bixiya talo baadhis ciideed bilaash ah, iyo barnaamijka soo iibinta hadhuudhka ee gudida badarka iyo soosaarka qaranka ee beeralayda galleyda.

English: Learn farming! Include agricultural education in schools.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kilimo! Jumuisha elimu ya kilimo shuleni.
Dholuo: Puonjri bedo japur! Ket weche mag pur e skunde.
Somali: Waxbarashada beeraha iskuulka ku dar.

English: This month's public update covers the national school feeding programme supporting learners in public primary schools, special needs and inclusive education support units in public schools, and Teachers Service Commission (TSC) recruitment of teachers for public schools.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha mpango wa kitaifa wa chakula shuleni unaosaidia wanafunzi wa shule za msingi za umma, vitengo vya elimu maalum na jumuishi katika shule za umma, na uajiri wa walimu wa TSC kwa shule za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o chenro mar chiwo chiemo e skul mag piny mangima ma konyo jopuonjre e skul mag sirkal, dwaro makende kod unit mag konyo somo ma oting'o ji duto e skul mag sirkal, kod Komison mar Tich mar Jopuonj (TSC) mar ng'ado jopuonj e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay qusaysaa barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada qaranka ee taageeraya ardayda wax ka barata dugsiyada hoose ee dadwaynaha, baahiyaha gaarka ah iyo qaybaha taageerada waxbarashada loo dhan yahay ee dugsiyada dawlada, iyo qoritaanka gudiga adeega macalimiinta (TSC) ee macalimiinta dugsiyada dawlada.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in the transition to Junior Secondary School (JSS) under the Competency Based Curriculum (CBC).
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpito kwenda shule ya upili ya chini (JSS) chini ya mtaala wa CBC.
Dholuo: Okwayo jopiny mondo okaw okang' mar loko skul mar sekondari (JSS) e bwo chenro mar somo ma ochung'ne nyalo (CBC).
Somali: Muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu booriyay inay ka qaybqaataan u gudubka Dugsiga Sare (JSS) ee hoos yimaada Manhajka Ku Salaysan Kartida (CBC).

English: Don't miss out — the national school feeding programme supporting learners in public primary schools is now open to the public.
Kiswahili: Usikose — mpango wa kitaifa wa chakula shuleni unaosaidia wanafunzi wa shule za msingi za umma sasa iko wazi kwa umma.
Dholuo: Okidwar ng'eyo — chenro mar chiwo chiemo e skul mag pinyno ma konyo jopuonjre e skul mag piny owacho sani oyabere ne ji duto.
Somali: Ha moogaanin - barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada qaranka ee taageeraya ardyada dugsiyada hoose ee dadwaynaha ayaa hadda u furan dadweynaha.

English: The government continues to expand the Digital Literacy Programme providing learning devices to primary schools.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaendelea kupanua Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Kidijitali unaotoa vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule za msingi.
Dholuo: Sirkal dhi nyime gi lando chenro mar somo gi ndiko mar Dijital ma miyo skul mag primary gige somo.
Somali: Dawladdu waxay sii waddaa inay balaadhiso Barnaamijka Akhriska Dijital ah oo siinaya qalab waxbarasho dugsiyada hoose.

English: Inclusive education policy launched – every school must admit disabled learners!
Kiswahili: Sera ya elimu jumuishi yazinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
Dholuo: Chenro mar somo ma oriwo ji duto osechako skul ka skul nyaka yie rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre!
Somali: Siyaasadda waxbarashada oo dhanka ka mid ah ayaa la bilaabay. Dugsi kasta waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

English: Teachers recommend combining regular homework review with regular attendance to address overcrowded classrooms.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kupitia kazi za nyumbani mara kwa mara na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia madarasa yenye msongamano.
Dholuo: Jopuonj golo paro ni mondo oriw somo mar tije mag ot pile ka pile kod chopo kanyakla mondo ilos klas ma opong' ahinya gi ji.
Somali: Macallimiintu waxay ku talinayaan inay isku daraan dib u eegista shaqada-guriyeedka caadiga ah iyo xaadiritaanka joogtada ah si wax looga qabto fasallada ciriiriga ah.

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: the transition to Junior Secondary School (JSS) under the Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) and the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: mpito kwenda shule ya upili ya chini (JSS) chini ya mtaala wa CBC na lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo.
Dholuo: Kauntino timo chenro machalre: lokore mondo odonj e skul ma malo (JSS) e bwo chenro mar somo ma ochung'ne nyalo (CBC) kod mbui mar KUCCPS mar keto jogo ma dwaro dhi e yunivasiti kod kolej.
Somali: Degmadu waxa ay waddaa qorshayaal is barbar socda: u gudbida Dugsiga Sare (JSS) ee hoos yimaada Manhajka Ku-salaysan Kartida (CBC) iyo meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha.

English: Publish learning resources 2022.
Kiswahili: Chapisha nyenzo za kujifunzia 2022.
Dholuo: Goyo buge mag puonjruok e higa 2022.
Somali: Daabac ilo waxbarasho sanadka 2022.

English: For a complete picture, residents should review both the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications and free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools.
Kiswahili: Ili kupata picha kamili, wakazi wanapaswa kuangalia lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo na sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma.
Dholuo: Mondo iyud picha ma opong'o, jodak onego otim nonro kuom yore ariyo mag KUCCPS mag keto ji e yunivasiti kod kolej kod chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Si loo helo sawir dhammaystiran, dadka deegaanka waa inay dib u eegaan labadaba bogga meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha iyo siyaasadda waxbarashada dugsiga hoose iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: This month's public update covers the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications, KCSE and KCPE examination registration through the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC), and Teachers Service Commission (TSC) recruitment of teachers for public schools.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo, usajili wa mitihani ya KCSE na KCPE kupitia KNEC, na uajiri wa walimu wa TSC kwa shule za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar apar gi ji duto ochung'ne ng'ado bura mar KUCCPS mar keto jopuonjre e skul madongo kod kolej, ndiko nying' e penj mag KCSE kod KCPE kokalo kuom bura mar penj mag piny Kenya (KNEC), kod ng'ado bura mar jopuonj e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay daboolaysaa bogga meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha, diiwaangelinta imtixaannada KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo Golaha Imtixaanaadka Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC), iyo Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) qoritaanka macallimiinta dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: Take advantage of the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications available to eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Nufaika na lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo inayopatikana kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Ti gi thuolo mar KUCCPS mar keto kwayo mag yunivasiti kod kolej ma yudore ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Ka faa'iidayso meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha ee ay heli karaan deganayaasha xaqa u leh.

English: This week's outreach covers NG-CDF bursary applications for needy students through local constituency offices and KCSE and KCPE examination registration through the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC).
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha maombi ya bursary ya NG-CDF kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kupitia ofisi za eneobunge na usajili wa mitihani ya KCSE na KCPE kupitia KNEC.
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Oganda ma jumano biro puonjo ji mondo ondiki kwayo mag pesa mag NG-CDF ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro kokalo kuom apis mag gwenge mag gwenge kod ndiko nying' e penj mag KCSE kod KCPE kokalo kuom bura mar penj mag piny Kenya (KNEC).
Somali: Wacyigelinta usbuucan waxa ay khusaysaa codsiyada NG-CDF ee ardayda danyarta ah iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada deegaanka doorashada iyo diiwaangelinta imtixaannada KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo Golaha Imtixaanaadka Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC).

English: Graduation at Machakos University with 2039 graduates.
Kiswahili: Kuhitimu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Machakos na wahitimu 2039.
Dholuo: E kinde ma ne itiekoe tiegruok e Yunivasiti mar Machakos, ne nitie ji 2,039.
Somali: Ka qalin jabisay Jaamacadda Machakos oo leh 2039 ka qalin jabisay.

English: Teach safety! Include abduction prevention in curricula.
Kiswahili: Fundisha usalama! Jumuisha kuzuia utekaji nyara katika mitaala.
Dholuo: Teach safety! Include abduction prevention in curricula.
Somali: Wax bar nabadgelyada, ka hortagga afduubka ku dar barnaamijyada waxbarasho.

English: Residents can access three key services: the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications, free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools, and the Digital Literacy Programme providing learning devices to primary schools.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo, sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma, na Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Kidijitali unaotoa vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule za msingi.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: KUCCPS mar keto ji e yunivasiti kod kolej, chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal kod somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal, kod Program mar somo mar Dijital ma chiwo gige somo e skul mag piny.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: Xariirka meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha, siyaasadda waxbarashada dugsiga hoose iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dadweynaha, iyo Barnaamijka Akhriska Dijital ah oo siiya qalab waxbarasho dugsiyada hoose.

English: Residents can access three key services: free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools, the Digital Literacy Programme providing learning devices to primary schools, and Teachers Service Commission (TSC) recruitment of teachers for public schools.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma, Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Kidijitali unaotoa vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule za msingi, na uajiri wa walimu wa TSC kwa shule za umma.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal kod somo mar sekondari ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal, Program mar somo mar Dijital ma chiwo gige somo e skul mag sirkal, kod Komison mar Tich mar Jopuonj (TSC) ma ng'ado bura mar jopuonj e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: siyaasadda waxbarashada dugsiga hoose iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dadweynaha, Barnaamijka Akhriska Dijital ah oo siinaya qalab waxbarasho dugsiyada hoose, iyo Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) qoritaanka macallimiinta dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: Encourage your child to practice responsible internet use to improve their learning.
Kiswahili: Mhamasishe mtoto wako kufanya matumizi ya kuwajibika ya intaneti ili kuboresha ujifunzaji wake.
Dholuo: Jiw nyathini mondo otim puonjruok mar tiyo kod intanet e yo makare mondo omed somo maber.
Somali: Ku dhiiri geli ilmahaaga inuu ku celceliyo isticmaalka interneedka masuuliyada leh si loo horumariyo waxbarashadooda.

English: Local leaders are working with residents on free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa eneo wanashirikiana na wakazi kuhusu sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag gwenge tiyo kanyakla gi jodak e wi chik mar somo ma nono mar primary kod sekondari ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Hogaamiyayaasha deegaanku waxay dadka deegaanka kala shaqaynayaan siyaasada waxbarashada aasaasiga ah iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dawlada.

English: KUCCPS third revision opens tomorrow – change your course before it's too late!
Kiswahili: Marekebisho ya tatu ya KUCCPS yanafunguliwa kesho badilisha mwelekeo wako kabla haijachelewa!
Dholuo: KUCCPS somo mar adek chako kiny lok yo ma idhi luwo kapok sa odeko ahinya!
Somali: Dib-u-eegiskii saddexaad ee KUCCPS wuxuu furmayaa berrito. Isbeddel koorsadaada ka hor inta aysan noqonin mid aad u gaabis ah!

English: Any unsafe classroom conditions affecting learners at Early Childhood Development Education should be raised during the new school calendar discussions.
Kiswahili: hali isiyo salama ya darasa yoyote inayoathiri wanafunzi katika elimu ya awali inapaswa kuibuliwa wakati wa majadiliano ya kalenda mpya ya shule.
Dholuo: Gik moko duto ma ok ber ma nyalo timore e klas ma mulo jopuonjre e somo mar dongruok mar nyithindo matindo onego oting' e kinde ma itimoe mbaka mag kalenda manyien mar skul.
Somali: Xaalad kasta oo aan badbaado lahayn oo saamaynaysa ardyada Waxbarashada Horumarinta Carruurnimada Hore waa in la sara kiciyaa inta lagu guda jiro wada-hadallada kalandarka cusub ee dugsiga.

English: Officials are urging the public to consider the transition to Junior Secondary School (JSS) under the Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) alongside KCSE and KCPE examination registration through the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC).
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza umma kuzingatia mpito kwenda shule ya upili ya chini (JSS) chini ya mtaala wa CBC pamoja na usajili wa mitihani ya KCSE na KCPE kupitia KNEC.
Dholuo: Jotelo dwaro ni oganda opar matut kuom loko skul mar sekondari (JSS) e bwo puonj ma ochung'ne nyalo (CBC) kaachiel gi ndiko penj mar KCSE kod KCPE kokalo kuom bura mar penj mag piny Kenya (KNEC).
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku boorinayaan dadweynaha inay tixgeliyaan u gudbida Dugsiga Sare (JSS) ee hoos yimaada Manhajka Ku-saleysan Kartida (CBC) oo ay weheliso diiwaangelinta imtixaannada KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo Golaha Imtixaanaadka Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC).

English: Raise awareness! Schools, educate on GBV prevention.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Shule, toa elimu kuhusu kuzuia GBV.
Dholuo: Meduru ji ng'eyo! Skunde, puonjre kuom geng'o GBV.
Somali: Iskuulada, wacyi galinta ka hortagga cudurka GBV.

English: Community members are advised to check on the transition to Junior Secondary School (JSS) under the Competency Based Curriculum (CBC).
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanashauriwa kuangalia mpito kwenda shule ya upili ya chini (JSS) chini ya mtaala wa CBC.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag gwenge opuonjore mondo otim nonro kuom lokruok ma dhi e skul ma malo (JSS) e bwo chenro mar somo ma ochung'ne nyalo (CBC).
Somali: Xubnaha bulshada waxa lagula talinayaa in ay hubiyaan u gudbida Dugsiga Sare (JSS) ee hoos yimaada Manhajka Ku Salaysan Kartida (CBC).

English: Building time management early helps learners succeed under the CBC curriculum.
Kiswahili: Kujenga usimamizi wa muda mapema husaidia wanafunzi kufaulu chini ya mtaala wa CBC.
Dholuo: Kugero yore mag tiyo kod thuolo mapiyo konyo jopuonjre mondo gibed gi loch e bwo chenro mar somo mar CBC.
Somali: Dhisida maaraynta wakhtiga goor hore waxay caawisaa ardayda inay ku guulaystaan ​​manhajka CBC.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on NG-CDF bursary applications for needy students through local constituency offices, the Digital Literacy Programme providing learning devices to primary schools, and KCSE and KCPE examination registration through the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC).
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu maombi ya bursary ya NG-CDF kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kupitia ofisi za eneobunge, Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Kidijitali unaotoa vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule za msingi, na usajili wa mitihani ya KCSE na KCPE kupitia KNEC.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso tich matek e wi kwayo mag pesa mag NG-CDF ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro kokalo kuom opis mag gwenge mag gwenge, chenro mar somo gi ndiko gige somo ne skul ma piny, kod ndiko penj mag KCSE kod KCPE kokalo kuom bura mar penj mag piny Kenya (KNEC).
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada codsiyada NG-CDF ee loogu talagalay ardayda tabaalaysan iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada deegaanka doorashada, Barnaamijka Akhriska Dijital ah oo siinaya qalab waxbarasho dugsiyada hoose, iyo diiwaangelinta imtixaannada KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo Golaha Imtixaannada Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC).

Kiswahili: Wizara imethibitisha uungwaji mkono unaoendelea wa vitengo vya elimu maalum na jumuishi katika shule za umma.

Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay xaqiijisay sii wadida taageerada baahiyaha gaarka ah iyo waaxaha taageerada waxbarashada loo dhan yahay ee dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: Officials are urging the public to consider Higher Education Loans Board (HELB) loan and bursary applications alongside the national school feeding programme supporting learners in public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza umma kuzingatia maombi ya mkopo na bursary ya HELB pamoja na mpango wa kitaifa wa chakula shuleni unaosaidia wanafunzi wa shule za msingi za umma.

English: Officials remind the public about free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanakumbusha umma kuhusu sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma.
Dholuo: Jotelo paro ne oganda kuom chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag piny owacho.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay xasuusinayaan dadweynaha siyaasadda waxbarashada aasaasiga ah iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dawladda.

English: In addition to NG-CDF bursary applications for needy students through local constituency offices, residents can also benefit from free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools.
Kiswahili: Mbali na maombi ya bursary ya NG-CDF kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kupitia ofisi za eneobunge, wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi kwayo mag bursary mag NG-CDF ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro kokalo kuom ofise mag gwenge mag gwenge, jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Marka lagu daro codsiyada NG-CDF ee deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda baahan iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada deegaanka, dadka deegaanka waxay sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan karaan siyaasadda waxbarashada dugsiga hoose iyo maalinta bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications, free primary and free day secondary education policy in public schools, and special needs and inclusive education support units in public schools.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo, sera ya elimu ya msingi na sekondari ya kutwa bila malipo katika shule za umma, na vitengo vya elimu maalum na jumuishi katika shule za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar apar ni nyiso kaka KUCCPS nyalo keto ji e skul mag yunivasiti kod kolej, chik mar somo ma onge chudo e skul mag sirkal, kod dwaro makende kod unit mag konyo somo ma oting'o ji duto e skul mag sirkal.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarnigu waxa uu iftiiminayaa bogga meelaynta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha, siyaasadda waxbarashada dugsiga hoose iyo dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada dawladda, iyo baahiyaha gaarka ah iyo qaybaha taageerada waxbarashada loo dhan yahay ee dugsiyada dawladda.

Somali: Kormeerka heerarka ka bixitaanka fasaxa saddexda bilood ee 2020.

Somali: Saxiixidda qaabka dib u soo noqoshada shaqada ee jaamacadaha.

English: Officials remind the public about the KUCCPS placement portal for university and college applications.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanakumbusha umma kuhusu lango la KUCCPS la maombi ya vyuo vikuu na vyuo.

Kiswahili: Bwenzi wote lazima wawe na njia za dharura za kutokea - ukaguzi unaanza Desemba 1!

Somali: Dhammaan qolka hoyga waa in ay leeyihiin albaabada degdegga ah. Kormeerka wuxuu bilaabmayaa 1-da Diseembar!

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, and public participation forums in county budget-making processes.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo, kwayo barupe mag ofis kokalo kuom mbui ma iluongo ni eCitizen, kod chokruoge mag ng'ado bura mar ji duto e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, codsanaya dukumentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen ah, iyo golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta gobolka.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen ma kawuono nyiso kaka IEBC ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu kapok yiero ochopo, kwayo barupe mag ofis kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, kod lendo mag sirkal mar kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ochiw.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni waxa uu iftiiminayaa diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, ka codsanaya dukumentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen ah, iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda hoose ee bixinta adeegga.

English: The public notice board has been updated with information on accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Ubao wa matangazo ya umma umesasishwa na taarifa kuhusu kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Bod mar lendo mar ji duto oseloso gi weche ma mulo kaka inyalo yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche.
Somali: Boodhka ogeysiiska dadwaynaha ayaa lagu cusboonaysiiyay macluumaadka ku saabsan helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka.

English: This week's outreach covers reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC) and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC) na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Oboke ma jumani kae oting'o lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar weche mag tim makare kod weche mag ketho chik (EACC) kod lendo mag sirkal mag kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ochiw ne loch.
Somali: Wacyigelinta usbuucan waxa ay khusaysaa ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC) iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda degmada ee ku saabsan bixinta adeegga.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar apar ni nyiso kaka IEBC ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu kapok yiero ochopo, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod lendo mag sirkal mag kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ochiw.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni waxa uu iftiiminayaa diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, helitaanka xogta dawladda ee hoos timaada Xeerka Helitaanka macluumaadka, iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda hoose ee adeeg bixinta.

English: To reduce unfair resource allocation, the county is expanding access to passport application services this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza ugawaji usio wa haki wa rasilimali, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa huduma za maombi ya pasipoti mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' ng'iewo mwandu ma ok owinjore, kauntino medo ng'iewo gik moko e higa ni.
Somali: Si loo dhimo qoondaynta kheyraadka ee aan cadaalad ahayn, degmadu waxay kordhinaysaa helitaanka adeegyada codsiga baasaboorka sanadkan.

English: A public briefing has been scheduled to discuss resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha umma kimepangwa kujadili kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Ne oket chenro mar timo romo mar ji duto mondo olos kaka inyalo tieko ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Waxaa loo ballamay kulan xog-waraysi ah oo lagaga hadlayo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court, and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo, na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich mar lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Rieko kod Kedo kod Ketho (EACC), loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Ketho Matin, kod konyo jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada ku aaddan warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwooyinka Yaryar, iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Citizens who understand the devolution process are better placed to report nepotism in hiring when it occurs.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaoelewa mchakato wa ugatuzi wako katika nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuripoti upendeleo katika uajiri inapotokea.
Dholuo: Jodak ma winjo tiend yo mar keto teko e piny, gin joma nigi thuolo maber mar lando wach mar ng'anjo mar jowetegi e ng'ado tich ka otimore.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta fahamsan habka awood-qeybsiga waxay ku habboon yihiin inay ka warbixiyaan qaraabo-kiil marka ay dhacdo shaqaaleysiinta.

English: Report via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551 in case you have specific corruption cases which need action.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551 ikiwa una kesi maalum za ufisadi zinazohitaji hatua.
Dholuo: Chiw lipot kitiyo gi e-mail report@integrity.go.ke kata luong namba 1551 kapo ni in gi weche moko ma nyiso ni idwaro kawo okang'.
Somali: Ka warbixi emailka report@integrity.go.ke ama wac 1551 haddii aad qabtid kiisas musuqmaasuq gaar ah oo u baahan tallaabo.

English: Take advantage of resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court available to eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Nufaika na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo inayopatikana kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Ti gi thuolo mar loso weche matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin ma yudore ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Ka faa'iidayso xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar oo ay heli karaan dadka deggan ee xaqa u leh.

English: Community members are advised to check on filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA).
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanashauriwa kuangalia kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag gwenge omiye paro mondo otim nonro kuom keto ywak mag rito jopolisi ne IPOA.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshada waxa lagula talinayaa in ay hubiyaan xeraynta cabashooyinka booliiska ee Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA).

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine youth empowerment forums participation with awareness of the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika mabaraza ya uwezeshaji wa vijana na uelewa wa nafasi ya mdhibiti malalamiko.
Dholuo: Jotelo jiwo jodak mondo oket kanyakla bedo e forum mag miyo joma tindo teko kod ng'eyo tich ma jatend piny onego otim.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku dhiirigeliyaan muwaadiniinta inay isku daraan golayaasha xoojinta dhalinyarada iyo ka qaybgalka wacyiga doorka gardoonka.

English: If you have any particular cases of corruption you need to report, please do so via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una visa vyovyote maalum vya ufisadi unavyohitaji kuripoti, tafadhali fanya hivyo kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi wach moro ma chandi, inyalo ndiko wachno e adres mar@integrity.go.ke kata inyalo ywayo tol e namba mar 1551.
Somali: Haddii aad qabtid kiisas gaar ah oo musuqmaasuq ah oo aad u baahan tahay inaad soo sheegto, fadlan sidaas ku samee emailka report@integrity.go.ke ama wac 1551.

English: This month's public update covers accessing government services through Huduma Centres, resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court, and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma, kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo, na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom kuonde mag Huduma, loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom kot matin mar ng'ado bura, kod ng'ado bura mar sirkal mar piny mangima (NGAAF) ne jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa helitaanka adeegyada dawladda iyada oo loo marayo xarumaha Huduma, xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwooyinka Yaryar, iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA), resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court, and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA, kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo, na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich mar keto ywak mag rito polisi e Od Romo mar Rieko mar Polis (IPOA), loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin, kod konyo jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada ku saabsan gudbinta cabashooyinka booliiska ee Maamulka Madaxa-banaan ee Kormeerka Bilayska (IPOA), xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwooyinka Yaryar, iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Notice of by-election for Member of National Assembly for Wajir West Constituency scheduled to be held April 25th 2019.
Kiswahili: Notisi ya uchaguzi mdogo wa Mbunge wa Kitaifa wa Eneobunge la Wajir Magharibi uliopangwa kufanyika Aprili 25, 2019.
Dholuo: Oboke mar yiero mar jatend bura mar piny owacho mar Wajir ma milambo ma oket mondo otimre tarik 25 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2019.
Somali: Ogeysiiska doorashada ku celiska ah ee xubinta baarlamaanka qaranka ee deegaanka Wajeer ee loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoonto 25ka Abriil 2019.

English: Officials are urging the public to consider applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform alongside filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA).
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza umma kuzingatia kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen pamoja na kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA.
Dholuo: Jotelo dwaro ni oganda opar matut kuom keto kwayo mar yudo oboke mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen kaachiel gi keto ywak mag rito jopolisi ne IPOA.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku boorinayaan dadwaynaha inay tixgeliyaan codsiga dukumeentiyada rasmiga ah ee eCitizen on platformka iyada oo ay weheliso gudbinta cabashooyinka kormeerka bilayska ee Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA).

English: IEBC urges Kenyans to verify list of BBI supporters
Kiswahili: IEBC yawahimiza Wakenya kuthibitisha orodha ya wafuasi wa BBI
Dholuo: IEBC dwaro ni Jo-Kenya onon joma yieyo lwedo chenro mar BBI
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka Kenya ugu baaqeysaa inay xaqiijiyaan liiska taageerayaasha BBI

English: This notice is issued in the public interest concerning public participation forums in county budget-making processes.
Kiswahili: Tangazo hili linatolewa kwa maslahi ya umma kuhusu mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Oboke ni ogol e ber mar ji duto e wi forum mag ji duto ma nyalo bedo gi ng'iyo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiiskan waxa loo soo saaray danta guud ee khuseeya golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Update mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o forum mag ji duto ma nyalo bedo gi ng'iyo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: EACC urges all professional bodies in the country to infuse integrity and accountability in their self-regulatory mechanisms to enhance corruption intolerance among Kenyan professionals
Kiswahili: EACC inazihimiza taasisi zote za kitaaluma nchini kuingiza uadilifu na uwajibikaji katika mifumo yao ya kujidhibiti ili kuongeza uvumilivu wa ufisadi miongoni mwa wataalamu wa Kenya.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jolony duto e pinyno mondo otim gik moko e yo makare kendo e yo mowinjore mondo omi joma olony e Kenya obed gi chuny mar tiyo maonge gi mibadhi
Somali: EACC waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhamaan hay'adaha xirfadeed ee dalka inay daacadnimo iyo mas'uuliyad ku darsadaan nidaamyadooda is-xakamaynta si kor loogu qaado dulqaadka musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhexeeya xirfadlayaasha Kenya

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine public participation forums participation with awareness of voter rights and responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma na uelewa wa haki na wajibu wa mpiga kura.

Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku dhiirigeliyaan muwaadiniinta inay isku daraan ka-qaybgalka fagaarayaasha dadweynaha iyo wacyigelinta xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka codbixiyayaasha.

English: The public is reminded that accessing government services through Huduma Centres remains available this quarter.
Kiswahili: Umma unakumbushwa kuwa kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma inaendelea kupatikana robo hii.
Dholuo: Oganda iparo ni yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom Huduma Centres pod nitie e dwe mar ang'wen.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxa la xusuusinayaa in adeegyada dawladda laga heli karo xarumaha Huduma ay weli diyaar yihiin rubucii.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.

Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarnigu waxa uu iftiiminayaa ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos imanaya Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda hoose ee bixinta adeegyada la daadiyey.

English: Polling Stations for the By-Election Scheduled to be held on 8th December, 2022 In Bungoma County, Utawala, Ololmasani, Kyome/Thaana, South Gem and Mumias North Wards in Nairobi City, Narok, Kitui, Siaya and Kakamega Counties Respectively
Kiswahili: Vituo vya Kupigia Kura kwa Uchaguzi Mdogo Ulioratibiwa kufanyika tarehe 8 Disemba, 2022 Katika Kaunti ya Bungoma, Utawala, Ololmasani, Kyome/Thaana, Gem Kusini na Wadi za Mumias Kaskazini katika Jiji la Nairobi, Narok, Kitui, Kaunti za Siaya na Kakamega Mtawalia.
Dholuo: 2022 E gwenge mag Bungoma, Utawala, Ololmasani, Kyome/Thaana, South Gem kod Mumias North e gwenge mag Nairobi, Narok, Kitui, Siaya kod Kakamega
Somali: Goobaha Cod-bixinta ee Doorashada-Beddelka ah ee loo qorsheeyay in la qabto 8-da Diseembar, 2022 ee Ismaamulka Bungoma, Utawala, Ololmasani, Kyome/Thaana, South Gem iyo Mumias North Wards ee Magaalada Nairobi, Narok, Kitui, Siaya iyo Kakamega counties siday u kala horreeyaan.

English: Households can benefit from either accessing government services through Huduma Centres or National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups, depending on eligibility.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma au usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom kuonde mag Huduma kata kony mar sirkal mar piny mangima (NGAAF) ne joma nigi pek, kaluwore gi kaka ginyalo yudo kony.
Somali: Qoysasku waxa ay ka faa'iidaysan karaan helitaanka adeegyada dawladda iyada oo loo marayo xarumaha Huduma ama Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda Qaranka (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul, iyada oo ku xidhan u-qalmitaanka.

English: Residents attending public participation forums can also learn how to access passport application services on the spot.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaohudhuria mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma wanaweza pia kujifunza jinsi ya kupata huduma za maombi ya pasipoti papo hapo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dhi e chokruoge mag ji duto bende nyalo ng'eyo kaka ginyalo yudo kony mar kwayo pasport e kanyo.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee ka qayb galaya golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha waxay sidoo kale baran karaan sida loogu helo adeegyada codsiga baasaboorka isla goobta.

English: IEBCKenya urges our donors to continue supporting the Commission to implement activities in the 2023-2027 electoral cycle
Kiswahili: IEBCKenya inawasihi wafadhili wetu kuendelea kuiunga mkono Tume kutekeleza shughuli katika mzunguko wa uchaguzi wa 2023-2027.
Dholuo: Jatend duol mar yiero IEBC , KENYA kwayo komisona mondo odhi nyime riwo lwedo kamisona e tich mar yiero mar higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod adek -alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod abiriyo.
Somali: IEBCKenya waxay ku boorineysaa deeq bixiyeyaasheena inay sii wadaan taageerada ay u yeeshaan Komishanka si ay u hirgeliyaan hawlaha wareegga doorashada 2023-2027

Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti au kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom bedo gi chokruoge mag ji duto e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kata loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin, kaluwore gi ng'at ma owinjore.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada ama xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar, iyadoo ku xidhan u-qalmitaanka.

English: The relevant government department has released details about filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA).
Kiswahili: Idara husika ya serikali imetoa maelezo kuhusu kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA.
Dholuo: Ofis mar sirkal ma ochung'ne wechego osegolo weche matut kuom keto ywak mar ng'ado bura mar ng'ado bura ne jopolisi e ofis mar ng'ado bura mar ng'ado bura (IPOA).
Somali: Waaxda dawladda ee ay khusayso ayaa soo bandhigtay faahfaahin ku saabsan u gudbinta cabashooyinka booliiska ee Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA).

English: You can now apply for disability registration services online through the eCitizen portal.
Kiswahili: Sasa unaweza kuomba huduma za usajili wa ulemavu mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa eCitizen.
Dholuo: Koro inyalo ndiko kwayo mar kony mar ndiko nying jogo mowong'o e mbui kokalo e mbui mar eCitizen.
Somali: Waxaad hadda ka dalban kartaa adeegyada diiwaangelinta naafada onlaynka eCitizen portal.

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine community development meetings participation with awareness of the Huduma Namba registration system.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika mikutano ya maendeleo ya jamii na uelewa wa mfumo wa usajili wa Huduma Namba.
Dholuo: Jotelo jiwo jodak mondo oket kanyakla bedo e chokruoge mag dongruok mag oganda kod ng'eyo kaka inyalo ndiko nying' Huduma Namba.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan muwaadiniinta inay isku daraan ka qaybgalka shirarka horumarinta bulshada iyo wacyigelinta nidaamka diiwaangelinta Huduma Namba.

English: In addition to reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), residents can also benefit from accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Mbali na kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chiwo ripot mar mibadhi ne Komiti mar Weche Kire kod Mibadhi (EACC), jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom yudo weche mag sirikal e bwo Chik Maduong' mar Yudo Weche.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), dadka deegaanka waxay sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan karaan helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada sharciga helitaanka macluumaadka.

English: Residents seeking support can look into IEBC voter registration ahead of elections or reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC).
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaotafuta usaidizi wanaweza kuangalia usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi au kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC).
Dholuo: Jodak ma dwaro kony nyalo ng'iyo weche mag ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo kata lando weche mag ketho chik ne komiti mar weche mag ketho chik (EACC).
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee taageerada doonaya waxay eegi karaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashada ama inay musuqmaasuq u soo sheegaan Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC).

English: Appointment of Returning and Deputy Returning Officers for Purposes of the By-Elections for Member of National Assembly for Olkalou Constituency, Nyandarua County Scheduled to be held on Thursday, 16th July, 2026
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa Wasimamizi wa Uchaguzi na Manaibu Wasimamizi wa Uchaguzi kwa Madhumuni ya Uchaguzi Mdogo wa Mbunge wa Jimbo la Olkalou, Kaunti ya Nyandarua Uliopangwa kufanyika Alhamisi, Julai 16, 2026.
Dholuo: Oketo jotelo mabiro yiero kod jotelo ma luwogi mondo otim yiero mabiro timore mar Jatend Bura mar Pinyruoth e Distrikt mar Olkalou, e Distrik mar Nyandarua.
Somali: Magacaabida Saraakiisha Soo Celinta iyo Ku Xigeenada Soo Celinta Ujeedooyinka Doorashada Xubnaha Baarlamaanka Qaranka ee Deegaanka Olkalou, Degmada Nyandarua oo loo qorsheeyay in la qabto Khamiista, 16ka Luulyo, 2026

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: public participation forums in county budget-making processes, accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: chokruoge mag keto ji e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod kony ma sirkal mar pinyno chiwo (NGAAF) ne jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, helitaanka xogta dawladda ee hoos timaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Create a TIMS account via http://ntsa.go.ke register account then apply for the smart dl, book appointment then visit our offices for biometric registration.
Kiswahili: Fungua akaunti ya TIMS kupitia akaunti ya kujiandikisha ya http://ntsa.go.ke kisha omba huduma ya smart dl, weka miadi ya kuweka miadi kisha tembelea ofisi zetu kwa usajili wa kibiometriki.
Dholuo: Yaw akaunt mar TIMS kitiyo gi mbui mar http://ntsa.go.ke yaw akaunt kendo ikwa barupi mar riembo , kwa romo kendo ili apise magwa mondo okaw nonro kokalo kuom lith lweti.
Somali: Abuur koonto TIMS adoo adeegsanaya koontada diiwaangelinta http://ntsa.go.ke ka dibna dalbo diiwaangelinta smart dl, ballan dhig ka dibna booqo xafiisyadeena diiwaangelinta biometric.

English: The community outreach agenda includes IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lando wach e kind oganda oriwo ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo, lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar weche mag tim makare kod ketho chik (EACC), kod lendo mag sirkal mar kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado.
Somali: Ajendaha wacyi gelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashada, ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee guddiga anshaxa iyo la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa (EACC), iyo ogeysiisyada maamulka gobolka ee ku saabsan bixinta adeegyada.

English: Officials are coordinating accessing government services through Huduma Centres together with accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanaratibu kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma pamoja na kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Jotelo loso chenro mar yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom Huduma Centers kaachiel gi yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay isku dubaridinayaan helitaanka adeegyada dawladda iyagoo sii maraya xarumaha Huduma oo ay weheliyaan helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka.

English: Attend a civic education forum to learn about voter rights and responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Hudhuria jukwaa la elimu ya uraia kujifunza kuhusu haki na wajibu wa mpiga kura.
Dholuo: Dhi e chokruok mar somo mar oganda mondo ing'e kuom ratiro kod ting' mag jogo ma goyo ombulu.
Somali: Ka qaybgal madasha waxbarashada madaniga ah si aad wax uga barato xuquuqaha iyo waajibaadka codbixiyayaasha.

English: This PSA highlights applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform for residents to note.
Kiswahili: Tangazo hili linaangazia kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen kwa wakazi kuzingatia.
Dholuo: PSA ni nyiso kaka inyalo kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen mondo jodak ong'e.
Somali: PSA-dan waxa ay iftiiminaysaa codsiga dukumeentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online ah eCitizen si ay dadka deegaanka u ogaadaan.

English: Citizens who understand how county budgets work are better placed to report electoral malpractice when it occurs.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaoelewa jinsi bajeti za kaunti zinavyofanya kazi wako katika nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuripoti udanganyifu wa uchaguzi inapotokea.
Dholuo: Jodak ma winjo tiend kaka bajet mag kaunti tiyo, gin joma nigi thuolo maber mar lando tim marach mag yiero ka otimore.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta fahmaya sida miisaaniyada degmadu u shaqeyso ayaa si fiican loo meeleeyaa si ay uga warbixiyaan khaladaadka doorashada marka ay dhacdo.

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: IEBC voter registration ahead of elections and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Kauntino timo chenro machalre: ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo kod konyo jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Degmadu waxay waddaa qorshayaal is barbar socda: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka iyo taageerada Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee kooxaha nugul.

English: Community members can access applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform as well as public participation forums in county budget-making processes through local offices.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanaweza kupata kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen pamoja na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti kupitia ofisi za eneo.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag gwenge nyalo yudo thuolo mar kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen kaachiel gi forum mag ji duto ma nyalo bedo gi ng'iyo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kokalo kuom ofise mag gwenge.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshadu waxay heli karaan codsiga dukumeentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen ah iyo sidoo kale golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada deegaanka.

English: Residents can access three key services: public participation forums in county budget-making processes, accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: forum mag ng'ado bura mar oganda e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: Understanding how county budgets work makes it easier to report misuse of public funds when you see it.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa jinsi bajeti za kaunti zinavyofanya kazi hurahisisha kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma unapoiona.
Dholuo: Ka ing'eyo kaka bajet mag kaunti tiyo, mano miyo bedo mayot mondo ior ripot mar tiyo marach gi pesa mag piny ka inene.
Somali: Fahamka sida ay u shaqeyso miisaaniyada degmadu waxay kuu fududaynaysaa inaad ka warbixiso si xun u isticmaalka hantida dadweynaha markaad aragto.

English: Public Participation and Stakeholder Engagement: In accordance with Article 10(2) of the Constitution of Kenya, the Ministry of Roads and Transport invites members of the public and stakeholders to participate in public forums.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa Umma na Ushiriki wa Wadau: Kwa mujibu wa Kifungu cha 10(2) cha Katiba ya Kenya, Wizara ya Barabara na Uchukuzi inawaalika wananchi na wadau kushiriki katika mijadala ya umma.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Oganda kod jokanyo: Kaluwore gi Sula mar apar (ariyo) mar Chik mar Kenya, Migao mar weche wuoth gwelo ji duto manie riwruok mar oganda kod jokanyo mondo oriwre e chenro moriwo oganda.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka dadweynaha iyo ka qaybgalka daneeyayaasha: Sida ku cad qodobka 10 ((2) ee Dastuurka Kenya, Wasaaradda Wadooyinka iyo Gaadiidka waxay ku casuumaysaa xubnaha dadweynaha iyo daneeyayaasha inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha.

English: Residents can access three key services: applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), and accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), na kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chike kod Kedo Weche mag Oganda (EACC), kod yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: ka codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen, ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), iyo helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos imanaya Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka.

English: This month's public update covers public participation forums in county budget-making processes, reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), and accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), na kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oriwo chokruoge mag ji duto ma nyalo bedo gi ng'iyo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti, lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar weche mag tim makare kod ketho chik (EACC), kod yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), iyo helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos imanaya Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka.

English: For more information, visit your nearest county office regarding filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA).
Kiswahili: Kwa maelezo zaidi, tembelea ofisi ya kaunti ya karibu kuhusu kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA.
Dholuo: Ka idwaro ng'eyo mathoth, dhi e ofis mar kaunti man machiegni kodi kuom keto ywak mar ng'ado bura kuom ng'ado bura ne jopolisi (IPOA).
Somali: Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah, booqo xafiiska degmada kuugu dhow ee ku saabsan ka xeraynta cabashooyinka kormeerka bilayska Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA).

English: Both public participation forums in county budget-making processes and reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC) are available this month for eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Zote mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti na kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC) zinapatikana mwezi huu kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Gik moko ariyo ma ji nyalo timo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kod lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chike kod Kedo mar Ketho (EACC) nitie e dwe mar apar ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Labada gole ee ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee habraacyada miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada iyo ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC) ayaa diyaar u ah bishan deganeyaasha xaqa u leh.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod konyo jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: ka codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal online eCitizen ah, helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Xogta, iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Both IEBC voter registration ahead of elections and resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court are available this month for eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Zote usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo zinapatikana mwezi huu kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Giduto, ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo kod loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin, nitie e dwe mar apar ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Labada diiwaangelin ee IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka iyo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar ayaa diyaar u ah bishan dadka deggan ee xaqa u leh.

English: Any suspected delayed government services can be reported anonymously through the ethics hotline.
Kiswahili: huduma za serikali kuchelewa yoyote inayoshukiwa inaweza kuripotiwa bila kujulikana kupitia laini ya maadili.
Dholuo: Gimoro amora ma igeno ni tije mag sirkal osechopo e kinde ma inyalo ng'adne bura ma ok ong'ere kokalo kuom namba mar ng'ado bura.
Somali: Wax kasta oo looga shakiyo in ay dib u dhac ku yimaad adeegyada dawladda waxa lagu soo wargelin karaa si qarsoodi ah iyada oo loo marayo khadka telefoonka ee anshaxa.

English: Notice of By-Elections for Members of the National Assembly for Embakasi South and Ugenya Constituencies and County Assembly Ward Member for Lelan Ward, Elegeyo Marak Wet County Assembly Scheduled To Be Held On 5th April, 2019
Kiswahili: Notisi ya Uchaguzi Mdogo wa Wabunge wa Majimbo ya Embakasi Kusini na Ugenya na Mbunge wa Wadi ya Lelan, Bunge la Kaunti ya Elegeyo Marak Wet Uliopangwa Kufanyika Tarehe 5 Aprili, 2019.
Dholuo: Oboke mar Yiero Maduong' mar Jokanyo mag Bura mar Pinyruoth mag Embakasi ma Nyanduat kod Ugenya kod Jokanyo mag Bura mar Kaunti mar Lelan, Bung' mar Kaunti mar Elegeyo Marak Wet Oketo ni Otimre tarik 5 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2019
Somali: Ogeysiiska Doorashooyinka isreebreebka ee Xubnaha Golaha Shacbiga ee Koonfur Embakasi iyo Deegaanka Ugenya iyo Xubinta Golaha Degaanka ee Ward Lelan Ward, Elegeyo Marak Golaha Degaanka Qoyan ee Golaha Degaanka ee loo qorsheeyay in la qabto 5ta Abriil, 2019

English: Residents attending anti-corruption awareness campaigns can also learn how to access disability registration services on the spot.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaohudhuria kampeni za uhamasishaji dhidi ya ufisadi wanaweza pia kujifunza jinsi ya kupata huduma za usajili wa ulemavu papo hapo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dhi e kampen mag puonjo ji e wi tim mar ketho chik bende nyalo ng'eyo kaka ginyalo yudo kony mar ndiko nying' jogo ma nigi nyawo mag del e kanyo.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee ka qaybgalaya ololaha wacyigelinta ka hortagga musuqmaasuqa waxay sidoo kale baran karaan sida loo helo adeegyada diiwaangelinta naafada isla goobta.

English: Local radio stations have been asked to air updates on resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya redio vya eneo vimeombwa kutangaza taarifa kuhusu kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Ne okwayo redio mag alwora mondo ogol weche ma nyasani e wi kaka inyalo tieko ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Idaacadaha maxaliga ah ayaa la waydiistay inay siidaayaan wararka ku saabsan xalinta khilaafaadka yar yar iyada oo loo marayo maxkamada sheegashooyinka yaryar.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: accessing government services through Huduma Centres, applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, and filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA).
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma, kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, na kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom Senta mag Huduma, kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, kod keto ywak mag rito polisi e Od Romo mar Rieko mar Polis (IPOA).
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: ka helidda adeegyada dawladda ee xarumaha Huduma, ka codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah ee internetka eCitizen, iyo u gudbinta cabashooyinka booliska ee kormeerka Hay'adda Madaxbanaan ee Kormeerka Bilayska (IPOA).

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA), and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: kwayo barupe mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, keto ywak mag rito jopolisi e Od Romo mar Jopolisi (IPOA), kod lendo mag sirkal mar kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ochiw ne loch.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: ka codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah ee loo maro madal online eCitizen ah, ka xeraynta cabashooyinka kormeerka bilayska ee Maamulka Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxbanaan (IPOA), iyo ogaysiisyada dawlada hoose ee bixinta adeega.

English: Residents can call their local office for help accessing resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
