Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupigia ofisi yao ya eneo kwa msaada wa kupata kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo goyo simu ne ofis ma ni e alworagi mondo okonygi yudo yore mag loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay wici karaan xafiiska deegaanka si ay uga caawiyaan xalinta khilaafyada yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Sheegashada Yaryar.

English: Returning Officer for the Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) by-election Moureen Kerebi Oyaro urges voters and media to observe Covid-19 protocol.
Kiswahili: Afisa Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi mdogo wa Wadi ya Bunge la Kaunti ya Nguu/Masumba (CAW) Moureen Kerebi Oyaro anawasihi wapiga kura na vyombo vya habari kuzingatia itifaki ya Covid-19.
Dholuo: Apisa mochung'ne yiero maduondo Nguu/ e wod mar Kaunti mar Masumba Moureen Kerebi Oyaro, kwayo jogo ombulu mondo oluw chik mar tuo mar Covid-19.
Somali: Sarkaalka soo noqnoqda ee doorashada gaarka ah ee Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) Moureen Kerebi Oyaro wuxuu codbixiyayaasha iyo warbaahinta ku boorinayaa inay u hoggaansamaan borotokoolka COVID-19.

English: Residents attending town hall meetings can also learn how to access national ID replacement on the spot.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaohudhuria mikutano ya hadhara wanaweza pia kujifunza jinsi ya kupata ubadilishaji wa kitambulisho cha taifa papo hapo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dhi e chokruoge mag od bura mar taon bende nyalo ng'eyo kaka ginyalo yudo ID mar pinyno e kanyo.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee ka qaybgalaya shirarka hoolka magaalada waxay sidoo kale baran karaan sida loo helo beddelka aqoonsiga qaranka isla goobta.

English: Election Result Path, Complimentary Mechanism for Result Transmission and Voting Time for Kenyan Voters Residing Outside the Country for the General Election Scheduled to be held on 9th August, 2022.
Kiswahili: Njia ya Matokeo ya Uchaguzi, Utaratibu wa Kutosheleza wa Usambazaji wa Matokeo na Muda wa Kupiga Kura kwa Wapiga Kura wa Kenya Wanaoishi Nje ya Nchi kwa ajili ya Uchaguzi Mkuu ulioratibiwa kufanyika tarehe 9 Agosti, 2022.
Dholuo: Yo mar Duoko mar Yiero, Yore Mabeyo mar Oro Duoko kod Seche mag Goyo Ombulu ne Jo Kenya ma Odak e Piny Mako mar Yiero Maduong' ma Oketo ni otimre tarik 9 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022.
Somali: Dariiqa Natiijada Doorashada, Farsamaynta Habboon ee Gudbinta Natiijooyinka iyo Wakhtiga Codbixinta ee Cod-bixiyayaasha Kenya ee deggan dalka dibaddiisa ee Doorashada Guud ee loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoonto 9ka Agoosto, 2022.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen.
Dholuo: Okwayo jopiny mondo okaw okang' mar kwayo otepe mag sirkal kokalo e mbui mar eCitizen.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu booriyay inay ka qaybqaataan codsashada dukumentiyada rasmiga ah ee loo maro madal online-ka ah eCitizen.

English: Attention: IEBC voter registration ahead of elections is now available in your area.
Kiswahili: Angalizo: usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi sasa inapatikana katika eneo lako.
Dholuo: Par: Ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo sani nitie e alworau.
Somali: Fiiro gaar ah: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka hadda waa laga heli karaa degaankaaga.

English: Households can benefit from either public participation forums in county budget-making processes or accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, depending on eligibility.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti au kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom romo mag ji duto ma nyalo bedo gi ng'iyo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kata yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kaluwore gi ng'at ma owinjore.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada ama helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyadoo ku xidhan u-qalmitaanka.

English: Laikipia residents urged to join NHIF to avoid seeking hospital waivers
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Laikipia wahimizwa kujiunga na NHIF ili kuepuka kuomba msamaha wa hospitali
Dholuo: Jo-Laikipia ojiw mondo oriwre gi NHIF mondo giwe manyo thieth manono.
Somali: Dadka deggan Laikipia ayaa lagu booriyay inay ku biiraan NHIF si looga fogaado in ay raadsadaan caymiska isbitaalka

English: Make sure your household benefits from reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC).
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kaya yako inanufaika na kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC).
Dholuo: Ne ni joodu yudo ber kuom lando wach mar ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chik kod Kedo mar Kedo Mar Oganda (EACC).
Somali: Hubi in qoyskaagu uu ka faa'iidaysanayo warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC).

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: public participation forums in county budget-making processes and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Kaunti timo chenro machalre: chokruoge mag keto ji duto e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kod kony ma sirkal mar pinyno chiwo (NGAAF) ne jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Degmadu waxa ay waddaa qorshayaal is barbar socda: golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee habraacyada miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada iyo taageerada dawladda qaranka ee Afirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) ee kooxaha nugul.

English: Participate in anti-corruption awareness campaigns to have your voice heard in local decisions.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika kampeni za uhamasishaji dhidi ya ufisadi ili sauti yako isikike katika maamuzi ya eneo lako.
Dholuo: Inyalo donjo e kampen mag puonjo ji e wi ketho chik mondo dwondi owinjre e yiero ma itimo e alwora.
Somali: Ka qayb qaado wacyigelinta ka hortagga musuqmaasuqa si codkaaga loo maqlo go'aamada maxaliga ah.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on public participation forums in county budget-making processes, reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), and National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), na usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich matek e chokruoge mag keto ji e chenro mar loso bajet mar kaunti, lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chike kod Kedo kod Ketho (EACC), kod konyo jogo ma nigi pek.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada ku aaddan golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee geeddi-socodyada miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), iyo Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul.

English: Community members can access public participation forums in county budget-making processes as well as reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC) through local offices.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanaweza kupata mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti pamoja na kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC) kupitia ofisi za eneo.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag gwenge nyalo yudo thuolo mar bedo gi ng'iyo mar oganda e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti kaachiel gi lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chike kod Kedo kod Ketho (EACC) kokalo kuom ofise mag gwenge.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshadu waxay heli karaan golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada iyo sidoo kale warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC) iyada oo loo marayo xafiisyada maxalliga ah.

English: This month's public update covers IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, filing police oversight complaints with the Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA), and resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kuwasilisha malalamiko ya usimamizi wa polisi kwa IPOA, na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Update mar dwe ni ji duto oting'o weche mag ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo, keto ywak mag rito jopolisi e bura mar rito jopolisi (IPOA), kod loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar ng'ado bura matindo.
Somali: Warka dadwaynaha ee bishan ayaa ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, u gudbinta cabashooyinka kormeerka bilayska ee Hay'adda Kormeerka Bilayska ee Madaxa-banaan (IPOA), iyo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: The community outreach agenda includes IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, public participation forums in county budget-making processes, and reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC).
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, na kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC).
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lando wach e kind oganda oriwo ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo, chokruoge ma ji duto nyalo bedogo e chenro mag loso bajet mar kaunti, kod lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Kedo kod Oganda (EACC).
Somali: Ajendaha wacyigelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, fagaarayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee habraacyada miisaaniyad-samaynta kowntiga, iyo ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee guddiga anshaxa iyo la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa (EACC).

English: This quarter's briefing highlights resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court, National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups, and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo, usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Oboke ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado e dwe mar ang'wen, ogolo ler kuom loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar ng'ado bura matindo, ng'ado bura mar sirkal mar piny mangima (NGAAF) ne jogo ma nigi pek, kod lendo mag sirkal mar kaunti kuom chiwo tich ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-kan waxa uu iftiiminayaa xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwooyinka Yaryar, Taageerada Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta Dawladda ee Qaranka (NGAAF) ee kooxaha nugul, iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda hoose ee bixinta adeegga la daadiyey.

English: The public is reminded that National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) support for vulnerable groups remains available this quarter.
Kiswahili: Umma unakumbushwa kuwa usaidizi wa Mfuko wa NGAAF kwa makundi hatarini inaendelea kupatikana robo hii.
Dholuo: Oganda iparo ni kony ma Sirkal mar Pinyruoth chiwo ne jogo ma nigi pek pod nitie e dwe mar ang'wen.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxa la xasuusinayaa in Sanduuqa Waxqabadka Xaqiijinta ee Dawladda Qaranku (NGAAF) ee taageerada kooxaha nugul ay weli diyaar yihiin rubucitan.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on public participation forums in county budget-making processes, reporting corruption to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC), and accessing government information under the Access to Information Act.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti, kuripoti ufisadi kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi (EACC), na kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa.
Dholuo: Ofis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich matek e chokruoge mag keto ji e chenro mar loso bajet mar kaunti, lando weche mag ketho chik ne Komiti mar Chike kod Kedo kod Ketho (EACC), kod yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ahi waxay isku dubaridinayaan dadaallada ku saabsan golayaasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee hababka miisaaniyad-samaynta degmada, ka warbixinta musuqmaasuqa ee Guddiga Anshaxa iyo La-dagaalanka Musuqmaasuqa (EACC), iyo helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos imanaya Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka.

English: National Police Service warns stakeholders about to improve service provision and urges them to stay alert to.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Polisi ya Kitaifa inawaonya wadau kuhusu kuboresha utoaji wa huduma na inawahimiza kuwa macho.
Dholuo: riwruog apisa mar obila mar National Police Service chiwo siem ne jogo motudore gi tijno ni gibiro medo timo dongruok e tijgi mar lendo kendo gikwayogi ni gisik ka girito.
Somali: Adeegga Booliska Qaranka wuxuu uga digay dhinacyada daneynaya inay hagaajiyaan bixinta adeegyada wuxuuna ku boorinayaa inay feejignaadaan.

English: Citizens who understand public participation in law-making are better placed to report corruption when it occurs.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaoelewa ushiriki wa umma katika utungaji sheria wako katika nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuripoti ufisadi inapotokea.
Dholuo: Jodak ma winjo tiend bedo gi ng'eyo mar oganda e keto chike, gin joma nigi thuolo maber mar lando wach mar ketho chik ka otimore.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta fahamsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee sharci-dejinta ayaa ku habboon inay soo sheegaan musuqmaasuqa marka uu dhaco.

English: Residents attending civic education drives can also learn how to access disability registration services on the spot.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaohudhuria kampeni za elimu ya uraia wanaweza pia kujifunza jinsi ya kupata huduma za usajili wa ulemavu papo hapo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dhi e chenro mag somo mar oganda bende nyalo ng'eyo kaka ginyalo yudo kony mar ndiko nying' jogo ma nigi nyawo mag del e kanyo.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee ka qayb galaya waxbarashada madaniga ah waxay sidoo kale baran karaan sida loo helo adeegyada diiwaangelinta naafada isla goobta.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on applying for official documents through the eCitizen online platform, accessing government information under the Access to Information Act, and resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu kuomba hati rasmi kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni wa eCitizen, kupata taarifa za serikali chini ya Sheria ya Upatikanaji wa Taarifa, na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso chenro mar keto kwayo mag oboke mag sirkal kokalo kuom mbui mar eCitizen, yudo weche mag sirkal e bwo chik mar yudo weche, kod loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar weche matindo.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada ku aaddan codsashada dukumeentiyada rasmiga ah iyada oo loo marayo madal khadka tooska ah ee eCitizen, helitaanka macluumaadka dawladda ee hoos imanaya Xeerka Helitaanka Macluumaadka, iyo xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: This month's public update covers IEBC voter registration ahead of elections, accessing government services through Huduma Centres, and county government notices on devolved service delivery.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi, kupata huduma za serikali kupitia Vituo vya Huduma, na matangazo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhusu utoaji wa huduma za ugatuzi.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o weche mag IEBC ma ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu kapok yiero ochopo, yudo kony mag sirkal kokalo kuom Senta mag Huduma, kod lendo mag sirkal mag kaunti kuom chiwo kony ma ogol.
Somali: Warka dadwaynaha ee bishan ayaa ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashooyinka, helitaanka adeegyada dawladda ee xarumaha Huduma, iyo ogaysiisyada dawladda hoose ee adeeg bixinta.

English: Officials are coordinating IEBC voter registration ahead of elections together with resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanaratibu usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC kabla ya uchaguzi pamoja na kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Jotelo loso chenro mar ndiko nying' jogo ma biro goyo ombulu e IEBC kapok yiero ochopo kaachiel gi loso ywak matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Saraakiisha ayaa isku dubaridinaya diwaan galinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ka hor doorashada iyadoo lagu xalinayo khilaafaadka yar yar iyada oo loo marayo maxkamada sheegashooyinka yar yar.

English: Community members are advised to check on resolving small disputes through the Small Claims Court.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanashauriwa kuangalia kutatua migogoro midogo kupitia Mahakama ya Madai Madogo.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag gwenge omiye rieko mondo otim nonro kuom loso weche matindo kokalo kuom Kot mar Kedo Matin.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshada waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay hubiyaan xallinta khilaafaadka yaryar iyada oo loo marayo Maxkamadda Dacwadaha Yaryar.

English: Local chiefs have been briefed to relay information on free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Machifu wa eneo wamepewa maelezo ya kusambaza kuhusu uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag gwenge oseyudo puonj mondo oter weche mag ng'eyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma onge chudo e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Madaxda deegaanka ayaa lagu wargeliyay inay macluumaadka ku saabsan cudurka qaaxada (TB) ee bilaashka ah lagu ogaado iyo daawaynta xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha loo gudbiyo.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich mar chiwo chanjo ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar chiwo chanjo e piny Kenya (KEPI), ng'eyo kod thieth mar tuoche mag TB (TB) ma nono e kuonde thieth mag oganda, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada ku saabsan tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Kenya ee Tallaalka (KEPI), ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baaritaanka cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula milo midogo mara kadhaa kwa siku ili kudhibiti kichefuchefu na kudumisha viwango vya nishati.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego ocham chiemo matin nyading'eny e odiechieng' mondo omi ginyagre gi wich bar kendo rito teko ma gin-go.
Somali: Dumarka uurka leh waa inay cunaan cunto yar yar dhowr jeer maalintii si ay ula qabsadaan caloolxumada oo ay u ilaaliyaan heerarka tamarta.

English: The community outreach agenda includes the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), and HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), na chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lando wach e kind oganda oriwo ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, chiwo chanjo ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma omedore mar chiwo chanjo (KEPI), kod chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma rowere mondo kik gibed gi tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako.
Somali: Ajendaha wacyigelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI), iyo tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka.

English: This week's outreach covers community health promoters (CHPs) offering household health education and referrals and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii (CHP) wanaotoa elimu ya afya na rufaa nyumbani na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ni oriwo jogo ma rito thieth mar oganda (CHPs) ma chiwo somo mar thieth mar ot kod ng'ado bura kod tich mar loso chenro mar anyuola ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag sirkal.
Somali: Wacyigelinta usbuucan waxa ay khusaysaa dhiirrigeliyeyaasha caafimaadka bulshada (CHPs) oo bixiya waxbarashada caafimaadka qoyska iyo gudbinta iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska oo lacag la'aana laga heli karo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: In addition to free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, residents can also benefit from child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Mbali na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chiwo pim mar HIV maonge chudo kod chiwo riwo paro e kuonde thieth mag oganda, jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom luwo dongruok mar nyithindo kod chiwo Vitamin A e wik mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago adeegyada baadhista iyo la-talinta HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, dadka deegaanka waxa kale oo ay ka faa'iidaysan karaan la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro toddobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: This week's outreach covers mental health support services under the national mental health action plan and child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Oboke ma jumani kae oting'o tich mar konyo jogo ma nigi tuwo mar paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi tuwo mar paro kod luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Wacyigelinta usbuucan waxa ay dabooshaa adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka iyo la socodka koritaanka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro usbuuca Malezi Bora.

English: Children exposed to smoke are more likely to develop asthma and respiratory infections.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaovuta moshi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata pumu na maambukizi ya njia ya upumuaji.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma madho ndawa hinyo bedo gi tuoche mag yueyo kaka ayaki.
Somali: Carruurta qiiqa la taaban karo waxay u badan yihiin inay qabaan asthma iyo cudurrada neefsashada.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), and distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), na usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, chiwo chanjo ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma omedore mar chanjo (KEPI), kod chiwo gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach ma nyalo nego suna mondo ogeng' malaria.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee diiwaangelinta caafimaadka caalamiga ah, tallaalka carruurta ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Talaalka Balaadhinta ee Kenya (KEPI), iyo qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ah ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada.

English: For a complete picture, residents should review both screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension and child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Ili kupata picha kamili, wakazi wanapaswa kuangalia uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Mondo iyud picha ma owinjore, jodak onego otim nonro kuom yore ariyo mag ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod ng'iyo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Si loo helo sawir dhammaystiran, dadka deegaanka waa in ay dib u eegaan labadaba baadhista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka iyo la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro toddobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: This month's public update covers routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, and free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o chiwo chanjo ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar chiwo chanjo ma pile ka pile e bwo chenro mar chiwo chanjo ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach mondo ogeng' malaria, kod chiwo pim mag HIV kod chiwo paro ma nono e kuonde thieth mag ji duto.
Somali: Warbixinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa talaalka joogtada ah ee caruurnimada ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhan ee Kenya ee Talaalka (KEPI), qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee mudada dheer jirta si looga hortago duumada, iyo baadhista HIV iyo latalinta bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Public health and civic offices are coordinating on child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za afya ya umma na uraia zinashirikiana kuhusu ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Ofis mag thieth kod sivil timo tudruok ewi luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Xafiisyada caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo madaniga ayaa iska kaashanaya la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro usbuuca Malezi Bora.

English: In addition to routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), residents can also benefit from mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Mbali na chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chiwo thieth ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma oting'o thieth (KEPI), jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom thieth mar thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar pinyno mar thieth mar paro.
Somali: Marka lagu daro tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Kenya ee Tallaalka (KEPI), dadka deegaanka waxay sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan karaan adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich matek e chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, ng'iyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod tich mar konyo jotuwo mag paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixiya daryeelka hooyada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah (TB) ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne tich mar chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma pod tin mondo kik oyud tuwo mar kansa mar ng'ut dhako, ng'iyo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora, kod tich mar keto chenro mar anyuola ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag sirkal.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, la socodka korriinka carruurta iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro toddobaadka Malezi Bora, iyo adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska oo lacag la'aana laga helayo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, chiwo thieth ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro ma Kenya ma omedore mar thieth (KEPI), kod pim mar tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo mar remo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) diiwaangelinta caafimaadka caalamiga ah, tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI), iyo baarista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Public offices remain open to assist residents with mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za umma zinaendelea kuwa wazi kusaidia wakazi na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Opis mag sirkal pod oyawore mondo okony jodak gi tich mar konyo jotuwo mag paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi thieth mar paro.
Somali: Xafiisyada dadweynuhu way u furan yihiin inay ka caawiyaan dadka degan adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha hawleedka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: They develop policies on public health and sanitation, ensuring the well-being of our communities.
Kiswahili: Wanaunda sera kuhusu afya ya umma na usafi wa mazingira, kuhakikisha ustawi wa jamii zetu.
Dholuo: Giloso chike mag thieth mar oganda kod ler, mondo gibed gi ngima maber e alworawa.
Somali: Waxay dejiyaan siyaasado ku saabsan caafimaadka bulshada iyo fayadhowrka, hubinta wanaagga bulshooyinkayada.

English: Outbreaks of hepatitis B are prevented through safe food handling and timely child growth monitoring.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya homa ya ini aina B huzuiwa kupitia utunzaji salama wa chakula na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Midhiero mag hepatitis B geng'o kokalo kuom tiyo maber gi chiemo kod luwo dongruok mar nyathi e kinde mowinjore.
Somali: Faafitaanka cagaarshow B waxaa lagaga hortagayaa hab-dhaqan badbaado leh oo cunto ah iyo la socoshada koritaanka ilmaha ee wakhtiga ku habboon.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar ji duto, chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth ma nono e kar thieth mag piny, kod pim mar tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee diiwaangelinta caafimaadka caalamiga ah, barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeel hooyooyin bilaash ah xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baadhista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida macaanka iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Residents can access three key services: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud kony mar thieth mar piny mangima, ng'iyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod kony mar thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: Diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah (TB) ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: WHO recommends improving the readiness of counties and health facilities to early detect and respond to the cholera outbreak as well as the reinforcement of coordination and multisectoral approaches.
Kiswahili: WHO inapendekeza kuboresha utayari wa kaunti na vituo vya afya kutambua mapema na kukabiliana na mlipuko wa kipindupindu pamoja na uimarishaji wa uratibu na mbinu za sekta mbalimbali.
Dholuo: WHO ogolo paro ni mondo ober bedo moikore mar kaunti kod kuonde thieth mondo ong'e kendo ochung'ne tuwo mar kolera mapiyo kaachiel gi keto teko e riwruok kod yore mag ng'ado bura ma ng'ato ka ng'ato onego otim.
Somali: WHO waxa ay ku talisay in la wanaajiyo u diyaargarowga gobollada iyo xarumaha caafimaadka si ay goor hore u ogaadaan ugana jawaabaan faafitaanka daacuunka iyo sidoo kale xoojinta isuduwidda iyo habab dhinacyo badan leh.

English: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kupata huzuni au wasiwasi. Ushauri nasaha na vikundi vya usaidizi vinaweza kusaidia.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo nyalo bedo gi kuyo kata bedo gi parruok. Grube mag kony nyalo konyo.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub waxay dareemi karaan murugo ama walaac.

English: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kidini chini ya Baraza la Makanisa Duniani wanahimiza serikali na nchi wafadhili kuongeza usaidizi wa Mfuko wa Dunia, ili kusaidia majibu endelevu kwa VVU, kifua kikuu, na malaria.
Dholuo: Jotend din manie bwo riwruok mar World Council of Churches jiwo sirkande koda pinje machiwo kony mondo omed kony ma riwruok mar Global Fund chiwo, mondo okony e kedo gi AYAKI, kahera, kod malaria.
Somali: Hogaamiyaasha Diimaha ee Golaha Kaniisadaha Adduunka waxay dowladaha iyo dalalka deeqda bixiya ku boorinayaan inay kordhiyaan taageerada Hay'adda Global Fund, si ay u caawiyaan jawaab celinta joogtada ah ee HIV, cudurka hargabka, iyo makaraayada.

English: Anyone showing signs of diabetes symptoms should also be checked for typhoid at a nearby clinic.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeonyesha dalili za dalili za kisukari pia anapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa homa ya matumbo katika kliniki ya karibu.
Dholuo: Ng'at moro amora ma nyiso ranyisi mag tuo mar sukari bende onego otimne nonro mar taifoid e klinik man machiegni.
Somali: Qof kasta oo ka muuqda calaamadaha calaamadaha sonkorowga waa in sidoo kale laga hubiyo tiifowga rugta caafimaadka u dhow.

English: Households are advised to keep updated on free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinashauriwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Jo ot opuonjore mondo gibed gi ng'eyo matut kuom pim mag HIV ma onge chudo kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la socdaan wararka ku saabsan adeegyada la-talinta iyo baaritaanka HIV ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Announcement that CHV-led malnutrition screenings will now include mental wellbeing checks.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba uchunguzi wa utapiamlo unaoongozwa na CHV sasa utajumuisha uchunguzi wa ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: Lando ni CHV-led malnutrition screening koro biro riwo nyaka paro mag paro.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in baaritaannada nafaqada xun ee uu hoggaaminayo CHV ay hada ka mid noqon doonaan baaritaano caafimaad maskaxeed.

English: This comprehensive approach aims to maximize outreach, fostering ongoing discussions on HIV prevention, and treatment, as well as addressing issues like sexual and gender-based violence, teen pregnancies, and COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Mbinu hii ya kina inalenga kuongeza uhamasishaji, kukuza mijadala inayoendelea kuhusu uzuiaji wa VVU na matibabu, pamoja na kushughulikia masuala kama vile unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia, mimba za utotoni na COVID-19.
Dholuo: Yo ma opong'o wechego nigi gombo mar medo chopo e piny, loso mbaka ma dhi nyime e wi geng'o tuo mar HIV, kod thieth, kaachiel gi loso weche kaka ng'anjo mar nindruok kod ng'anjo mar ng'ato gi ng'ato, bedo gi ich e kind joma tin, kod COVID-19.
Somali: Habkan dhammaystiran ayaa ujeedadiisu tahay in la kordhiyo wacyigelinta, kobcinta doodaha socda ee ka hortagga HIV, iyo daawaynta, iyo sidoo kale wax ka qabashada arrimaha sida galmada iyo rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga, uurka dhallinta, iyo COVID-19.

English: The public is reminded that child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week remains available this quarter.
Kiswahili: Umma unakumbushwa kuwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora inaendelea kupatikana robo hii.
Dholuo: Oganda iparo ni luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora pod nitie e dwe mar ang'wen ni.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxa la xasuusinayaa in la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro toddobaadka Malezi Bora ay weli diyaar yihiin rubuckan.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Okwayo jopiny mondo okaw okang' mar luwo dongruok mar nyithindo kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta ayaa lagu booriyay inay ka qaybqaataan la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro usbuuca Malezi Bora.

English: Announcement of series of county learning forums emphasizing breastfeeding support, community hygiene, and infant diet education.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mfululizo wa mabaraza ya kujifunza ya kaunti yanayosisitiza usaidizi wa kunyonyesha, usafi wa jamii, na elimu ya lishe ya watoto wachanga.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar romo mag county mar puonjruok ka gijiwo kony mar miyo nyithindo ma nyiri chiemo gi kanyono, rito ler mar alwora, kod puonjo nyithindo e wi chiemo.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida taxane ka mid ah goobaha barashada ee gobolka oo ku adkeysanaya taageerada naasnuujinta, nadaafadda bulshada, iyo waxbarashada cuntada ilmaha.

English: Partners on the ground are committed to provide support to the ongoing response efforts including support to primary health care and social mobilization by United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF).
Kiswahili: Washirika mashinani wamejitolea kutoa msaada kwa juhudi zinazoendelea za kukabiliana na hali hiyo ikiwa ni pamoja na usaidizi wa huduma za afya ya msingi na uhamasishaji wa kijamii na Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Kuhudumia Watoto (UNICEF).
Dholuo: Joma tiyo kanyakla e pinyno ochung' motegno mar chiwo kony ne tich ma dhi nyime mar dwoko ma oting'o kony ne thieth mokwongo kod loso gik moko e kind oganda gi riwruok mar nyithindo mag piny mangima (UNICEF).
Somali: Wada-hawlgalayaasha goobta jooga waxaa ka go'an in ay taageero u fidiyaan dadaallada wax ka qabashada ee socda oo ay ku jiraan taageerada daryeelka caafimaadka aasaasiga ah iyo abaabulka bulshada ee Sanduuqa Carruurta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNICEF).

English: The community outreach agenda includes HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lando wach e kind oganda oriwo keto chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma pod tin mondo kik oyud tuwo mar kansa mar ng'ut dhako, timo pim mar HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod pim mar tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod tuo mar presa.
Somali: Ajendaha wacyigelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, baarista HIV iyo la-talinta bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baaritaanka cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, community health promoters (CHPs) offering household health education and referrals, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii (CHP) wanaotoa elimu ya afya na rufaa nyumbani, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen nyiso chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, jogo ma konyo thieth mar oganda (CHPs) ma chiwo somo mar thieth e ot kod ng'ado bura, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuoche mag sukari kod tuoche mag remo.
Somali: Warbixinta kooban ee rubuc-tan waxa ay iftiimisay barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeelka hooyada ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, dhiirrigeliyeyaasha caafimaadka bulshada (CHPs) oo bixiya waxbarashada caafimaadka qoyska iyo gudbinta, iyo baadhista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida macaanka iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma rowere mondo kik giyud tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako, timo pim mag HIV kod chiwo paro ma nono e kar thieth mag piny, kod rito joot ma yudore ma onge chudo e klinik mag piny.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa la xasuusiyay seddex barnaamij oo socda: Talaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, baarista HIV iyo adeegyada la-talinta ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska oo lacag la'aana laga helayo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Announcement of influencer-led digital media campaign promoting self-care, destigmatization, and helpline awareness in mental wellness week.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kampeni ya vyombo vya habari vya kidijitali inayoongozwa na watu wenye ushawishi inayokuza utunzaji binafsi, udhalilishaji, na ufahamu wa simu ya usaidizi katika wiki ya ustawi wa akili.
Dholuo: Lando mar kampen mar digital media mitayo gi joma nigi teko mar jiwo ritruok ma ng'ato owuon timo, tieko wichkuot, kendo konyo ji ng'eyo kaka ginyalo rito ngimagi e kinde mar juma mar paro.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida olole warbaahinta dhijitaalka ah oo ay hogaamiyaan saameynayaashu si kor loogu qaado daryeelka naftiisa, ka-hortagga, iyo wacyi-gelinta khadka caawimaadda toddobaadka caafimaadka maskaxda.

English: The relevant government department has released details about the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage.
Kiswahili: Idara husika ya serikali imetoa maelezo kuhusu usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote.
Dholuo: Ofis mar sirkal ma ochung'ne wechego osegolo weche matut kuom ndiko nying' mar Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar ji duto.
Somali: Waaxda dawladda ee ay khusayso ayaa soo saartay faahfaahin ku saabsan diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah.

English: Residents can access three key services: free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: pim kod thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) maonge chudo e kuonde thieth mag sirikal, luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora, kod kony mag chano anyuola mayudore maonge chudo e klinik mag sirikal.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah (TB) ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro usbuuca Malezi Bora, iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska oo lacag la'aan laga heli karo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Schools can be safe havens for mental health education
Kiswahili: Shule zinaweza kuwa mahali salama pa elimu ya afya ya akili
Dholuo: Skunde nyalo bedo kar buok mar tiego nyithindo e weche mag tuoche mag paro
Somali: Dugsiyada waxay noqon karaan meel ammaan ah oo lagu barto caafimaadka dhimirka

English: This month's public update covers free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni ji duto oting'o ng'eyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma onge chudo e kar thieth mag ji duto, chiwo gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom thuolo malach ma nyalo nego suna mondo ogeng' malaria, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo mar remo.
Somali: Bishan warbixintii dadweynuhu waxay ku saabsan tahay baadhista iyo daawaynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada, iyo baadhitaanka cudurada aan la kala qaadin sida macaanka iyo dhiig karka.

English: The National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) Board of [...]
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Baraza la Kitaifa la Kudhibiti Magonjwa ya Sadaka (NSDCC) ya [...]
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Bod mar piny mangima mar rito tuoche ma nyalo mako ji mang'eny (NSDCC) ma [...]
Somali: Golaha Qaranka ee Xakamaynta Cudurrada Syndemic (NSDCC) ee Golaha […]

English: Households are advised to keep updated on routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI).
Kiswahili: Kaya zinashauriwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI).
Dholuo: Jo ot opuonjore mondo gibed gi ng'eyo matut kuom thieth ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma omedore mar thieth (KEPI).
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la socdaan wararka ku saabsan tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI).

English: Parents should watch for persistent cough in children and seek family planning services promptly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuchunga kikohozi cha kudumu kwa watoto na kutafuta huduma za uzazi wa mpango haraka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego orit ka nyithindo bedo gi ahola ma ok rum kendo gipenj kony mar keto chenro mar anyuola mapiyo.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa inay daawadaan qufaca joogtada ah ee carruurta oo ay si degdeg ah u raadsadaan adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska.

English: National Coordinating Committee affirming Kenya's pledges on food system reform, nutrition financing, and wellness pathways.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uratibu ikithibitisha ahadi za Kenya kuhusu mageuzi ya mfumo wa chakula, ufadhili wa lishe, na njia za ustawi.
Dholuo: Komiti mar National Coordinating Committee mar Kenya ma jiwo singo mag Kenya e wach loso chenro mag chiemo, yuto mag chiemo, kod yore mag ngima maber.
Somali: Guddiga Isuduwaha Qaranka oo xaqiijinaya ballanqaadyada Kenya ee ku saabsan dib u habeynta nidaamka cuntada, maalgelinta nafaqada, iyo wadooyinka caafimaadka.

English: This month's public update covers the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag sirkal, ng'iyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag sirkal, kod thieth mar konyo jotuwo mag paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay dabooshaa barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeelka hooyada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.
Dholuo: Mon ma eka obedo mine, ma chunygi onyosore, ma chunygi ool, kata ma chunygi ool, onego omany kony e weche thieth. Chandruok mabedoe bang' nyuol inyalo thiedhi.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub ee caloolxumo la kulma, oo ka baxsan, ama rajo la'aan ah waxay u baahan yihiin inay raadsadaan taageero caafimaad maskaxeed.

English: Formal launch of digital advocacy initiative mobilizing influencers and civil society to promote nutrient profiling, FOP labelling, and policy change.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa utetezi wa kidijitali unaowahamasisha watu wenye ushawishi na asasi za kiraia ili kukuza uainishaji wa virutubisho, uwekaji lebo wa FOP, na mabadiliko ya sera.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar digital advocacy mar choko jogo ma nigi teko kod oganda mar oganda mondo gijiw weche mag chiemo, keto alama mag FOP, kod loko chike.
Somali: Bilowga rasmiga ah ee dadaalka dhiirrigelinta dhijitaalka ah ee soo uruurinaya saameeyayaasha iyo bulshada rayidka ah si loo dhiirrigeliyo qaabeynta nafaqada, sumadda FOP, iyo isbedelka siyaasadda.

English: In addition to the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, residents can also benefit from free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Mbali na usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi ndiko nying' mar Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom ng'iyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB ma onge chudo e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, dadka deegaanka waxay sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan karaan ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta qaaxada (TB) ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, community health promoters (CHPs) offering household health education and referrals, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii (CHP) wanaotoa elimu ya afya na rufaa nyumbani, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: pogo gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom thuolo malach ma nyalo nego suna mondo ogeng' maleria, jogo ma rito thieth mar oganda (CHPs) ma chiwo somo mar thieth mar oganda kendo orogi e ot, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ah ee muddada dheer jirta si looga hortago duumada, dhiirrigeliyeyaasha caafimaadka bulshada (CHPs) oo bixiya waxbarashada caafimaadka qoyska iyo gudbinta, iyo baadhista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Outbreaks of hepatitis B are prevented through safe food handling and timely family planning services.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya homa ya ini aina B huzuiwa kupitia utunzaji salama wa chakula na huduma za uzazi wa mpango kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Twoche mag hepatitis B ogeng'o kokalo kuom tiyo maber gi chiemo ma ichamo kod chiwo kony mag komo anyuola e kinde mowinjore.
Somali: Falalka cagaarshowga B waxa lagaga hortagayaa hab-dhaqan badbaado leh oo cunto ah iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska ee wakhtiga ku habboon.

English: Men are encouraged to accompany their partners to antenatal clinics and support them during pregnancy and after childbirth. Male involvement improves outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wanahimizwa kuandamana na wenzi wao kwenye kliniki za ujauzito na kuwasaidia wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua. Ushiriki wa wanaume huboresha matokeo.
Dholuo: Ijiwo chwo mondo odhi gi mondegi e osiptande mag nyuol kendo konyogi e kinde ma gin gi ich koda bang' nyuol. Bedo gi chwo mang'eny konyo ahinya.
Somali: Ragga waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la socdaan lammaanahooda rugta caafimaad ee uurka ka hor iyo taageero inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada kadib.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar ji duto, timo pim mag HIV kod chiwo paro ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod tich mar loso chenro mar joot ma yudore ma onge chudo e klinik mag piny.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee diiwaangelinta caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, adeegyada la-talinta iyo baadhista HIV ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska oo lacag-la'aan laga heli karo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: This month's public update covers routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe ni mar ji duto oting'o chiwo thieth ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma omedore mar chiwo thieth (KEPI), timo pim mag HIV ma onge chudo kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag ji duto, kod chiwo kony mar thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay khusaysaa tallaalka caruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Kenya ee Talaalka (KEPI), baadhista HIV iyo la talinta bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Kauntino timo chenro machalre: chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth ma onge chudo e kar thieth mag piny owacho kod tich mar konyo thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar thieth mar paro.
Somali: Degmadu waxa ay waddaa qorshayaal is barbar socda: barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeelka hooyada ee bilaashka ah xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Learn more about first aid basics by visiting your community health worker.
Kiswahili: Jifunze zaidi kuhusu misingi ya huduma ya kwanza kwa kutembelea mhudumu wa afya wa jamii yako.
Dholuo: Ng'e mathoth kuom gik madongo mag kony mokwongo kuom dhi limo jatich mar thieth ma ni e alworau.
Somali: Baro wax badan oo ku saabsan aasaaska gargaarka degdegga ah adoo booqanaya shaqaalaha caafimaadka beeshaada.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen no nyiso kaka ibiro keto gik ma nyalo nego winyo ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach mondo ogeng' malaria, chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma hikgi tin mondo ogeng' tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako, kod chiwo kony mar thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi thieth mar paro.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni waxa uu iftiiminayaa qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka-ka-neecada ah ee muddada-dheer si looga hortago duumada, tallaalka HPV ee hablaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilma-mareenka, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Community members can access the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities as well as free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities through local offices.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanaweza kupata mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma pamoja na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma kupitia ofisi za eneo.
Dholuo: Jodak mag gwenge nyalo yudo chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny kaachiel gi tich mar timo pim mag HIV kod chiwo paro ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny kokalo kuom ofise mag alwora.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshadu waxay heli karaan barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeelka hooyada ee bilaashka ah xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo sidoo kale adeegyada baadhista iyo la talinta HIV ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyada oo loo sii marinayo xafiisyada deegaanka.

English: Local chiefs have been briefed to relay information on free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Machifu wa eneo wamepewa maelezo ya kusambaza kuhusu huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag gwenge oseyudo puonj mondo oter weche mag timo pim mag HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag oganda.
Somali: Madaxda deegaanka ayaa lagu wargeliyay inay gudbiyaan macluumaadka ku saabsan adeegyada la-talinta iyo baaritaanka HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: A Comprehensive Guide on Mental Health & Psychosocial Support during Covid-19 Pandemic
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa Kina wa Afya ya Akili na Usaidizi wa Kisaikolojia wakati wa Janga la Covid-19
Dholuo: Oboke matut kuom thieth mar paro kod kony mar paro e kinde ma tuo mar Covid-19
Somali: Tilmaame Dhameystiran oo ku saabsan Caafimaadka Maskaxda & Taageerada Cilmi-nafsiga Bulshada inta lagu jiro Faafida Covid-19

English: The county administration is keen to promote family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Utawala wa kaunti unahamasisha huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Otend pinyno nigi gombo mar keto chenro mar rito joot ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag sirkal.
Somali: Maamulka gobolku waxa uu jecelyahay in uu horumariyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska ee bilaashka ah ee laga helo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: pogo gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach ma nyalo nego suna mondo ogeng' malaria, ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo, kod chiwo kony mar thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi thieth mar paro.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada, baadhista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: This week's outreach covers free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke ma jumani kae oting'o ng'eyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kar thieth mag piny owacho kod tich mar loso chenro mar anyuola ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag piny owacho.
Somali: Wacyigelinta toddobaadkan waxa ay khusaysaa baadhista iyo daawaynta cudurka qaaxada ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska ee bilaashka ah ee laga helo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: This week's outreach covers routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI) and free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI) na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Oboke ma jumani kae oting'o chiwo thieth ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma oting'o thieth (KEPI) kod chiwo thieth ma nono mar HIV kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Wacyigelinta toddobaadkan waxa ay khusaysaa tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta ee Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI) iyo baadhista iyo la-talinta HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Health workers recommend learning about mental health support alongside practicing proper waste disposal at home.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya wanapendekeza kujifunza kuhusu usaidizi wa afya ya akili pamoja na kufanya utupaji sahihi wa taka nyumbani.
Dholuo: Jotich mag thieth nyiso ni nyaka ipuonjri kuom konyo thieth mar paro kaachiel gi puonjruok mar wito yugi e ot.
Somali: Shaqaalaha caafimaadku waxa ay ku talinayaan in ay bartaan taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka oo ay weheliso ku-dhaqanka qashin-qubka saxda ah ee guriga.

English: Officials are coordinating free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities together with child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanaratibu uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma pamoja na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Jotelo ochung' ne ng'eyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny kaachiel gi ng'iyo dongruok mar nyithindo kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Saraakiishu waxay isku dubaridinayaan ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha oo ay weheliyaan la socodka koritaanka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro usbuuca Malezi Bora.

English: Learn more about adolescent reproductive health by visiting your community health worker.
Kiswahili: Jifunze zaidi kuhusu afya ya uzazi kwa vijana kwa kutembelea mhudumu wa afya wa jamii yako.
Dholuo: Inyalo ng'eyo mathoth e wi ngima mar nyuol mar nyithindo ma rowere kuom dhi limo jatich mar thieth e alworau.
Somali: Baro wax badan oo ku saabsan caafimaadka taranka dhalinyarada adoo booqanaya shaqaalaha caafimaadka beeshaada.

English: Both free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension are available this month for eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Zote uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu zinapatikana mwezi huu kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Giduto, ng'iyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo, yudore e dwe mar apar ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Labadaba baadhista iyo daawaynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha iyo baadhista cudurada aan lakala qaadin sida macaanka iyo dhiig karka ayaa bishan loo heli karaa deganayaasha xaqa u leh.

English: Don't miss out — screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension is now open to the public.
Kiswahili: Usikose — uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu sasa iko wazi kwa umma.
Dholuo: Okidwar ng'iyo — ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo sani oyawore ne ji duto.
Somali: Ha seegin - baarista cudurrada aan la is qaadsiin karin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka ayaa hadda u furan dadweynaha.

English: Kenya reports record daily jump in Covid-19 cases; 123 new infections from 3,077 samples tested.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaripoti ongezeko kubwa la visa vya Covid-19 kila siku; maambukizi mapya 123 kutoka kwa sampuli 3,077 zilizopimwa.
Dholuo: Kenya chiwo ripot mar medruok mar kwan mar joma nigi Covid-19 pile ka pile; ji 123 ma nigi tuo manyien kuom sampul 3,077 ma ne otem.
Somali: Kenya waxay soo bandhigtay kororka maalinlaha ah ee kiisaska COVID-19; 123 cudurrood oo cusub oo laga soo qaatay 3,077 shaybaar oo la tijaabiyay.

English: A reminder has been sent out regarding free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Ukumbusho umetumwa kuhusu huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Ne ooro paro kuom timo pim mag HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Xusuusin ayaa la diray oo ku saabsan adeegyada la-talinta iyo baaritaanka HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Visit a health facility if you experience symptoms of dehydration.
Kiswahili: Tembelea kituo cha afya iwapo utaona dalili za upungufu wa maji mwilini.
Dholuo: Dhi e kar thieth ka iyudo ranyisi mag ng'ol mar pi e del.
Somali: Booqo rugta caafimaadka haddii aad isku aragto calaamadaha fuuq-baxa.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango wa kitaifa wa uingiliaji kati wa lishe katika ngazi za kaunti na kitaifa.
Dholuo: Lando wach chenro mar piny mangima mar yore mag chiemo e okang' mar counties kod piny mangima.
Somali: Soo bandhigida khariidadda waddooyinka qaranka ee tallaabooyinka nafaqada ee heer gobol iyo heer qaran.

English: Residents seeking support can look into screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension or family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaotafuta usaidizi wanaweza kuangalia uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu au huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dwaro kony nyalo ng'iyo ng'iyo tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo kata tich mar loso chenro mar anyuola ma yudore ma nono e klinik mag sirkal.
Somali: Deganeyaasha taageerada raadsada waxay eegi karaan baaritaanka cudurrada aan la is qaadsiin karin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka ama adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska ee bilaashka ah ee laga helo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, community health promoters (CHPs) offering household health education and referrals, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii (CHP) wanaotoa elimu ya afya na rufaa nyumbani, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen onyiso kaka ng'ato nyalo ng'eyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) ma nono e kar thieth mag piny, jogo ma rito thieth mar oganda (CHPs) ma chiwo somo mar thieth mar ot kendo orogi e kar thieth, kod tich mar loso chenro mar anyuola ma yudore ma nono e klinik mag piny.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-kan waxa uu iftiiminayaa ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta cudurka qaaxada (TB) ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, dhiirrigeliyeyaasha caafimaadka bulshada (CHPs) oo bixiya waxbarashada caafimaadka qoyska iyo gudbinta, iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska oo lacag la'aana laga helayo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: The relevant government department has released details about family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Idara husika ya serikali imetoa maelezo kuhusu huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Ofis mar sirkal ma ochung'ne wechego osegolo weche matut kuom tich mar rito joot ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag sirkal.
Somali: Waaxda dawladda ee ay khusayso ayaa soo bandhigtay faahfaahin ku saabsan adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska ee bilaashka ah ee laga helo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Combine safe disposal of medical waste with regular immunization services visits to stay healthy all year round.
Kiswahili: Changanya utupaji salama wa taka za hospitalini na ziara za mara kwa mara za huduma za chanjo ili kuwa na afya mwaka mzima.
Dholuo: Kod keto yugi mag thieth e yoo makare kod dhi e kar thieth pile ka pile mondo ibed gi ngima maber higa duto.
Somali: Isku dar qashin badbaado leh oo qashinka caafimaadka ah iyo booqashooyinka adeegyada tallaalka ee joogtada ah si aad u ahaato mid caafimaad qabta sanadka oo dhan.

English: A joint outreach programme covers both free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension this season.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa pamoja wa uhamasishaji unahusisha huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu msimu huu.
Dholuo: Program mar lando wach ma ji duto timo kanyakla oriwo timo pim mag HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kar thieth mag oganda kod pim mar tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo e kindeni.
Somali: Barnaamij wada jir ah oo wada jir ah ayaa daboolaya adeegyada baarista HIV iyo la-talinta ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo baarista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka xilligan.

English: Store sharp, toxic, or breakable items out of children's reach to prevent injuries.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi vitu vyenye ncha kali, sumu, au vinavyoweza kuvunjika mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha.
Dholuo: Geng' gik ma nyalo ng'ado, ma nigi sum, kata ma nyalo kethore mayot mondo nyithindo kik hinyre.
Somali: Waxyaabaha xasaasiga ah, sunta leh, ama burburka leh ka ilaali carruurta si looga hortago dhaawacyada.

English: A reminder has been sent out regarding HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Ukumbusho umetumwa kuhusu chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.
Dholuo: Ne ooro paro kuom wach mar keto chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma hikgi tin mondo kik giyud tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako.
Somali: Xusuusin ayaa la diray oo ku saabsan tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka.

English: Key causes of TB include undernutrition, HIV, alcohol use disorders, smoking, and diabetes. Get the word out! We can eradicate TB together
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za Kifua Kikuu ni pamoja na lishe duni, VVU, matatizo ya matumizi ya pombe, uvutaji sigara, na kisukari. Fahamu! Tunaweza kutokomeza Kifua Kikuu pamoja
Dholuo: Moko kuom gik madongo makelo TB gin kaka kech, ayaki, mer, madho ndawa, koda tuwo mar sukari. Landuru wachno! Wanyalo tieko tuwo mar kahera kanyachiel
Somali: Sababaha ugu waaweyn ee cudurka TB waxaa ka mid ah nafaqo la'aanta, HIV, cudurrada khamriga, sigaarka iyo sonkorowga.
