English: A public briefing has been scheduled to discuss screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha umma kimepangwa kujadili uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Ne oket chenro mar timo romo mar ji duto mondo olos kuom ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuoche mag sukari kod tuoche mag remo.
Somali: Kulan dadweyne ayaa loo ballamay in looga hadlo baaritaanka cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida macaanka iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Residents can access three key services: free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: ng'eyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) ma nono e kar thieth mag piny, chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma rowere mondo kik giyud kansa mar ng'ut dhako, kod kony mar loso chenro mar anyuola ma yudore ma nono e klinik mag piny.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, tallaalka HPV ee hablaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, iyo adeegyada qorsheynta qoyska oo bilaash ah oo laga helo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso chenro mar keto gik ma nyalo nego suna ma nyalo tiyo kuom thuolo malach mondo ogeng' maleria, timo pim mag HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag oganda, kod luwo dongruok mar nyithindo kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ah ee muddada dheer jirta si looga hortago duumada, baarista iyo la-talinta HIV-ga bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo la socodka korriinka carruurta iyo kaabista Vitamin A toddobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: Anyone showing signs of high fever should also be checked for whooping cough at a nearby clinic.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeonyesha dalili za homa kali pia anapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa kifaduro katika kliniki ya karibu.
Dholuo: Ng'at moro amora ma nyiso ranyisi mag liet maduong' bende onego otimne nonro mar ng'iyo ng'ato e klinik man machiegni.
Somali: Qofkasta oo muujinaya calaamadaha qandho sare waa in sidoo kale laga hubiyo xiiqdheerta rugta caafimaadka u dhow.

English: This week's outreach covers the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage and free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa wiki hii unahusisha usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Oboke ma jumani kae oting'o ndiko nying' mar Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima kod tich mar timo pim mar HIV ma onge chudo kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag oganda.
Somali: Wacyigelinta toddobaadkan waxa ay khusaysaa diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah iyo adeegyada baadhista iyo la-talinta HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Households can benefit from either the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage or HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, depending on eligibility.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote au chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom ndiko nying'gi e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima kata yudo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma rowere mondo kik giyud kansa mar ot mar dhako, kaluwore gi ng'at ma owinjore.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan midkoodna Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) diiwaangelinta caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah ama tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, iyadoo ku xiran u-qalmitaanka.

English: A community cooking contests elevate indigenous nutritious dishes and household dietary knowledge.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya upishi wa jamii huinua vyakula vyenye lishe vya asili na ujuzi wa lishe ya nyumbani.
Dholuo: Kinda mar loso chiemo e alworawa miyo ji ng'eyo kit chiemo ma ne yudore e alworano, kendo mano miyo joot bedo gi lony e weche mag chiemo.
Somali: Tartanka cuntada lagu kariyo ee bulshada ayaa kor u qaadi doona cuntooyinka nafaqada leh ee dadka deegaanka iyo aqoonta cuntada ee qoysaska.

English: Residents seeking support can look into routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI) or HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaotafuta usaidizi wanaweza kuangalia chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI) au chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.
Dholuo: Jodak ma dwaro kony nyalo ng'iyo kaka inyalo mi nyithindo thieth ma pile ka pile e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma ng'ado bura (KEPI) kata thieth mar HPV ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma rowere mondo kik gibed gi tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee taageerada raadinaya waxay eegi karaan tallaalka carruurnimada joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta ee Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI) ama tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen onyiso chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, ng'iyo kendo thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod tich mar konyo jotuwo mag paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Warbixintan kooban ee rubuc-qarnigu waxay iftiiminaysaa barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixisa daryeelka hooyada ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, and child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Padi iparo ne chenro adek madhi nyime: pim kod thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) maonge chudo e kar thieth mag oganda, pogo kuonde mag suna manyalo tiyo kuom thuolo malach mar geng'o maleria, kod luwo dongruok mar nyithindo kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: baadhista iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah (TB) ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada, iyo la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A todobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: The community outreach agenda includes the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lando wach e kind oganda oriwo ndiko nying' e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, ng'iyo kendo thieth mar tuoche mag ng'ut (TB) ma onge chudo e kuonde thieth mag oganda, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod tuo mar presa.
Somali: Ajendaha wacyigelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, baarista iyo daawaynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baarista cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: Officials are coordinating HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer together with mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanaratibu chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi pamoja na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Jotelo loso chenro mar chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma pod tin mondo ogeng' tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako kaachiel gi tich mar konyo jotuwo mag paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi thieth mar paro.
Somali: Saraakiisha ayaa isku dubaridinaya tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si ay uga hortagaan kansarka ilma-mareenka si ay ula socdaan adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Gov't increases SHA benefits for Cancer patients, adds real-time claims tracking
Kiswahili: Serikali haiongezi faida za SHA kwa wagonjwa wa Saratani, inaongeza ufuatiliaji wa madai ya wakati halisi
Dholuo: Sirkal medo kony mag SHA ne joma nigi tuo mar kansa, medo luwo kwayo e sa mowinjore
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay faa'iidooyinka SHA ee bukaanka Kansarka, waxay ku dartay raadinta sheegashada waqtiga dhabta ah

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on the Linda Mama programme providing free maternity care at public health facilities, free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mpango wa Linda Mama unaotoa huduma za uzazi bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge ochung' ne chenro mar Linda Mama ma chiwo thieth mar nyuol ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, timo pim mag HIV ma nono kod chiwo paro e kar thieth mag piny, kod ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod tuo mar presa.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada barnaamijka Linda Mama oo bixiya daryeelka hooyada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, baarista HIV iyo la-talinta bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baaritaanka cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: The community outreach agenda includes routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria, and free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya uhamasishaji wa jamii inajumuisha chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria, na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Ajenda mar lendo e kind oganda oriwo chiwo chanjo ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar Kenya ma omedore mar chanjo (KEPI), chiwo gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach mondo ogeng' malaria, kod chiwo pim mag HIV kod chiwo paro ma nono e kuonde thieth mag oganda.
Somali: Ajendaha wacyigelinta bulshada waxaa ka mid ah tallaalka carruurnimada joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Kenya ee Tallaalka (KEPI), qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada, iyo adeegyo la-talin iyo baaritaan HIV oo bilaash ah oo laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.
Dholuo: Kenya nyiso medruok mar joma nigi tuwo mar Mpox, ma sani gin 137 ka kaunti mag Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru ema nigi kwan mamalo moloyo mar joma nigi tuono.
Somali: Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa kororka kiisaska Mpox, oo hadda gaaraya 137 iyadoo degmooyinka Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru ay hogaaminayaan tirada ugu badan ee cudurrada.

English: Parents should watch for diabetes symptoms in children and seek dental checkups promptly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuchunga dalili za kisukari kwa watoto na kutafuta uchunguzi wa meno haraka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego orit ranyisi mag tuo mar sukari e nyithindgi kendo onego odhi otim nonro mar lak mapiyo.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa inay ka fiirsadaan calaamadaha cudurka macaanka ee carruurta oo ay si degdeg ah u raadsadaan baaritaannada ilkaha.

English: Anyone affected should reach out regarding child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliyeathirika anapaswa kuwasiliana kuhusu ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ang'ata ma oyudo hinyruok owinjore ochop ewi luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Qof kasta oo ay saamaysay waa inuu la xidhiidhaa la socodka korriinka ilmaha iyo kaabista Vitamin A inta lagu jiro toddobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: Households are reminded of three ongoing programmes: the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and child growth monitoring and Vitamin A supplementation during Malezi Bora week.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinakumbushwa kuhusu mipango mitatu inayoendelea: usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto na virutubisho vya Vitamini A wakati wa wiki ya Malezi Bora.
Dholuo: Jo ot iparo kuom chenro adek ma dhi nyime: ndiko nying' e duol mar thieth mar oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, pim kod thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) maonge chudo e kuonde thieth mag sirkal, kod luwo dongruok mar nyathi kod chiwo Vitamin A e kinde juma mar Malezi Bora.
Somali: Qoysaska waxa la xasuusinayaa saddex barnaamij oo socda: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee diiwaangelinta caafimaadka caalamiga ah, ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo la socodka korriinka carruurta iyo kaabista Vitamin A toddobaadka Malezi Bora.

English: Health officials warn residents to watch for signs of measles this season.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya wanaonya wakazi kuchunga dalili za surua msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag thieth onyiso jodak mondo orit ranyisi mag tuo mar ng'ut e kindeni.
Somali: Saraakiisha caafimaadka ayaa uga digaya dadka deegaanka inay daawadaan calaamadaha jadeecada xilli ciyaareedkan.

English: Both free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities and HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer are available this month for eligible residents.
Kiswahili: Zote uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma na chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi zinapatikana mwezi huu kwa wakazi wanaostahili.
Dholuo: Giduto, ng'iyo kod thieth mar tuo mar TB (TB) ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny kod chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma rowere mondo kik oyud tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako, nitie e dwe mar apar ne jodak ma owinjore.
Somali: Labadaba ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta qaaxada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka ayaa diyaar u ah dadka deegaanka ee xaqa u leh.

English: Talk to a health worker about adolescent reproductive health to protect your family's health.
Kiswahili: Zungumza na mhudumu wa afya kuhusu afya ya uzazi kwa vijana ili kulinda afya ya familia yako.
Dholuo: Wuo gi jatich mar thieth kuom thieth mar nyuol mar joma tin mondo orit ngima mar joodu.
Somali: Kala hadal shaqaalaha caafimaadka caafimaadka taranka dhalinyarada si aad u ilaaliso caafimaadka qoyskaaga.

English: This quarter's briefing highlights the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage, HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, and mental health support services under the national mental health action plan.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha robo hii kinaangazia usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote, chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, na huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili.
Dholuo: Oboke mar dwe mar ang'wen maeni nyiso kaka Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) osendikore mondo oyud thieth mar piny mangima, chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma rowere mondo ogeng' tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako, kod tich mar konyo thieth mar paro e bwo chenro mar thieth mar paro mar piny.
Somali: Xog-warranka rubuc-qarni wuxuu iftiiminayaa diiwaangelinta Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ee caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah, tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, iyo adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha waxqabadka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Weche madongo mag geng'o landruok mar Mpox: Kik ibed machiegni gi joma nigi ranyisi mag tuwono. Kik inyis ng'at machielo gik ma in-go, kaka togo, sende, kata lewni. Bed ng'ama ler kuom luoko lweteni kinde ka kinde.
Somali: Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo faafitaanka Mpox: Ka fogow inaad xiriir dhow la yeelato dadka muujinaya calaamadaha cudurka. Ha la wadaagin waxyaabaha shakhsi ahaaneed sida tuulooyinka, weelasha, ama dharka.

English: Community members are advised to check on HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanashauriwa kuangalia chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.
Dholuo: Jodak mag gwenge opuonjore mondo otim nonro mar ng'ado bura mar HPV ne nyiri ma hikgi tin mondo kik oyud tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako.
Somali: Xubnaha bulshada waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay hubiyaan tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka.

English: Vaccinate your child against hepatitis B at your nearest health centre.
Kiswahili: Chanja mtoto wako dhidi ya homa ya ini aina B katika kituo cha afya cha karibu.
Dholuo: Chiw nyathini chanjo mar hepatitis B e kar thieth man machiegni kodi.
Somali: Ka tallaal ilmahaaga cagaarshowga B xarunta caafimaadka ee kuugu dhow.

English: Residents can access three key services: routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), free tuberculosis (TB) diagnosis and treatment at public health facilities, and screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), uchunguzi na matibabu ya kifua kikuu (TB) bila malipo katika vituo vya afya vya umma, na uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: chiwo chanjo ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar chiwo chanjo e piny Kenya (KEPI), pim kod thieth mar tuo mar TB ma nono e kuonde thieth mag piny, kod pim mar tuoche ma ok landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo mar remo.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: Tallaalka joogtada ah ee carruurnimada ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Talaalka ee Kenya (KEPI), ogaanshaha iyo daawaynta tiibishada bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, iyo baaritaanka cudurrada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig-karka.

English: This month's public update covers screening for non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension, mental health support services under the national mental health action plan, and family planning services available free of charge at public clinics.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma ya mwezi huu inahusisha uchunguzi wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama kisukari na shinikizo la damu, huduma za usaidizi wa afya ya akili chini ya mpango wa kitaifa wa afya ya akili, na huduma za uzazi wa mpango zinazopatikana bure katika kliniki za umma.
Dholuo: Update mar dwe ni ji duto oting'o ng'iyo tuoche ma ok nyal landore kaka tuo mar sukari kod presa ma malo, tich mar konyo jogo ma nigi tuwo mar paro e bwo chenro mar piny mangima mar timo gik moko e wi thieth mar paro, kod tich mar keto chenro mar anyuola ma yudore maonge chudo e klinik mag piny.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta dadwaynaha ee bishan waxa ay dabooshaa baadhista cudurada aan la kala qaadin sida sonkorowga iyo dhiig karka, adeegyada taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka ee hoos yimaada qorshaha hawleedka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qaranka, iyo adeegyada qorshaynta qoyska oo lacag la'aana laga heli karo rugaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Households can benefit from either the Social Health Authority (SHA) registration for universal health coverage or community health promoters (CHPs) offering household health education and referrals, depending on eligibility.
Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na usajili wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) kwa bima ya afya kwa wote au wahamasishaji wa afya ya jamii (CHP) wanaotoa elimu ya afya na rufaa nyumbani, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Jo ot nyalo yudo ber kuom ndiko nying'gi e Ofis mar Thieth mar Oganda (SHA) mondo oyud thieth mar ji duto kata jogo ma rito thieth mar oganda (CHPs) ma chiwo somo mar thieth mar oganda kod ng'ado bura, kaluwore gi ng'at ma owinjore.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan midkoodna Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) diiwaangelinta caymiska caafimaadka caalamiga ah ama dhiirrigeliyaasha caafimaadka bulshada (CHPs) oo bixiya waxbarashada caafimaadka qoyska iyo gudbinta, iyadoo ku xidhan u-qalmitaanka.

English: Announcement that public service will now provide tele and in-person counselling services through Huduma Centres and hotline 1919.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba huduma ya umma sasa itatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha kwa njia ya simu na ana kwa ana kupitia Vituo vya Huduma na simu ya dharura 1919.
Dholuo: Lando ni sirkal koro biro chiwo tele kod weche mag ng'ato ka ng'ato kokalo kuom Huduma Centres kod hotline 1919.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in adeegga dadweynaha uu hadda bixin doono adeegyo la-talin telefishan iyo shakhsi ahaan iyada oo loo marayo Xarumaha Huduma iyo khadka tooska ah 1919.

English: Outbreaks of polio are prevented through proper waste disposal and timely cancer screening.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya polio huzuiwa kupitia utupaji sahihi wa taka na uchunguzi wa saratani kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Ogeng'o tuoche mag polio kokalo kuom wito yugi e yo makare kod timo pim mar kansa e kinde mowinjore.
Somali: Falalka dabaysha waxa lagaga hortagayaa qashin-qubka saxda ah iyo baadhista kansarka ee wakhtiga ku haboon.

English: Outbreaks of typhoid are prevented through boiling drinking water and timely dental checkups.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya homa ya matumbo huzuiwa kupitia kuchemsha maji ya kunywa na uchunguzi wa meno kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Gigeng'o tuoche mag taifoid kokalo kuom pi ma ng'ato madho ma ng'ich kendo timo nonro mag lak e kinde mowinjore.
Somali: Tiifowga ka dillaaca waxa lagaga hortagayaa biyo karkaraya oo la cabbo iyo baadhista ilkaha ee wakhtiga ku habboon.

English: Vaccinate your child against polio at your nearest health centre.
Kiswahili: Chanja mtoto wako dhidi ya polio katika kituo cha afya cha karibu.
Dholuo: Chiw nyathini chanjo mar tuo mar polio e kar thieth man machiegni kodi.
Somali: Ka tallaal ilmahaaga dabaysha xarunta caafimaadka ee kuugu dhow.

English: Health workers recommend learning about mental health support alongside practicing exclusive breastfeeding for six months at home.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya wanapendekeza kujifunza kuhusu usaidizi wa afya ya akili pamoja na kufanya kunyonyesha maziwa ya mama pekee kwa miezi sita nyumbani.
Dholuo: Jotich mag thieth wacho ni onego opuonjre kuom konyo thieth mar paro kaachiel gi puonjruok mar miyo nyathi thuolo mar pi kende kuom dweche auchiel e ot.
Somali: Shaqaalaha caafimaadku waxay ku talinayaan in ay bartaan taageerada caafimaadka dhimirka oo ay barbar socdaan ku celcelinta naas nuujinta gaarka ah muddo lix bilood ah guriga.

English: Alongside routine childhood immunization under the Kenya Expanded Programme on Immunization (KEPI), the public is reminded about HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na chanjo za kawaida za watoto chini ya Mpango wa Kenya wa Chanjo (KEPI), umma unakumbushwa kuhusu chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chiwo thieth ma pile pile ne nyithindo e bwo chenro mar chiwo thieth ma pile ka pile e bwo chenro mar chiwo thieth (KEPI), ji iparo kuom chiwo thieth mar HPV ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma rowere mondo kik giyud kansa mar ot mar dhako.
Somali: Marka lagu daro tallaalka carruurnimada ee joogtada ah ee hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Balaadhinta Tallaalka ee Kenya (KEPI), dadweynaha waxaa la xasuusinayaa tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka.

English: In addition to HPV vaccination for adolescent girls to prevent cervical cancer, residents can also benefit from free HIV testing and counselling services at public health facilities.
Kiswahili: Mbali na chanjo ya HPV kwa wasichana balehe kuzuia saratani ya shingo ya kizazi, wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na huduma za bure za upimaji na ushauri wa VVU katika vituo vya afya vya umma.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi chiwo chanjo mar HPV ne nyiri ma pod tin mondo kik giyud tuwo mar kansa mar ot mar dhako, jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom timo pim mar HIV ma onge chudo kod chiwo paro e kuonde thieth mag piny.
Somali: Marka lagu daro tallaalka HPV ee gabdhaha qaan-gaarka ah si looga hortago kansarka ilmo-galeenka, dadka deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan kara adeegyada la-talinta iyo baaritaanka HIV-ga ee bilaashka ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha.

English: Residents who have not yet accessed distribution of long-lasting insecticidal mosquito nets to prevent malaria are encouraged to do so.
Kiswahili: Wakazi ambao bado hawajapata usambazaji wa vyandarua vinavyodumu kwa muda mrefu kuzuia malaria wanahimizwa kufanya hivyo.
Dholuo: Jodak ma pok oyudo thuolo mar chiwo gik ma nyalo ketho winyo ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach mondo ogeng' tuo mar malaria, jiwogi mondo gitim kamano.
Somali: Dadka deegaanka ee aan weli helin qaybinta maro-kaneecada cayayaanka ah ee muddada dheer si looga hortago duumada ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sidaas sameeyaan.

English: Residents can access three key services: the toll-free gender-based violence (GBV) helpline for reporting abuse, NTSA road safety campaigns on seatbelt use and speed limits, and Kenya Red Cross emergency response teams for disaster-affected communities.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: laini ya bure ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia (GBV) ya kuripoti unyanyasaji, kampeni za usalama barabarani za NTSA kuhusu matumizi ya mkanda wa usalama na mwendo, na timu za majibu ya dharura za Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na maafa.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: simu mar kony ma onge chudo mar ng'ado bura kuom ng'anjo ma ng'ato otimo, kampen mag NTSA mag rito ng'ato e yore e wi tiyo kod gik ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado e wi mtoka kod ng'ado ng'wech mapiyo, kod simu mar Kenya ma konyo e kinde mag masira.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: khadka caawinta ee rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga ee lacag-la'aanta ah (GBV) ee ka warbixinta xadgudubyada, NTSA ololayaasha badbaadada waddooyinka ee isticmaalka suunka iyo xadka xawaaraha, iyo kooxaha ka jawaabista degdegga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas ee Kenya ee bulshooyinka ay masiibada saamaysay.

English: Public health and civic offices are coordinating on the Nyumba Kumi community policing initiative for neighbourhood security.

Kiswahili: Kaya zinaweza kunufaika na usajili wa Huduma Namba chini ya mfumo wa kitaifa wa usimamizi wa utambulisho au timu za majibu ya dharura za Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na maafa, kulingana na sifa.
Dholuo: Padi nyalo yudo ber kuom ndiko nying' mar Huduma Namba e bwo chenro mar rito ng'eyo mar pinyno kata jodongo mag Kenya Red Cross mag konyo konyo oganda moyudo masira, kaluwore kod ratiro mar yudo kony.
Somali: Qoysasku waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan midkood diiwaangelinta Huduma Namba ee hoos timaada nidaamka maaraynta aqoonsiga qaranka ama kooxaha ka jawaabista degdegga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas ee Kenya ee bulshooyinka ay masiibada saamaysay, iyadoo ku xidhan u-qalmitaanka.

English: Local offices are coordinating efforts on the Nyumba Kumi community policing initiative for neighbourhood security, the Anti-FGM Board's campaigns against female genital mutilation, and the National Disaster Operations Centre's flood and drought early-warning alerts.
Kiswahili: Ofisi za eneo zinaratibu juhudi kuhusu mpango wa Nyumba Kumi wa ulinzi wa jamii kwa usalama wa mitaa, kampeni za Bodi ya Kupambana na Ukeketaji dhidi ya ukeketaji wa wanawake, na tahadhari za mapema za mafuriko na ukame kutoka Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Uendeshaji wa Maafa.
Dholuo: Opis mag gwenge loso chenro mar rito jopolisi mag Nyumba Kumi mondo orit jodak ma machiegni, kampen mag Bod ma kwedo FGM ma kwedo ng'ado ng'ut mon, kod ng'ado bura ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado e wi ng'anjo kod oro.
Somali: Xafiisyada maxalliga ah ayaa isku dubaridinaya dadaallada booliska ee beesha Nyumba Kumi ee amniga xaafadda, ololaha Guddiga Ka-hortagga Gudniinka Fircooniga ah ee ka dhanka ah gudniinka fircooniga ah, iyo Xarunta Hawlaha Masiibooyinka Qaranka ee digniinta hore ee fatahaadaha iyo abaaraha.

English: An official statement has been issued regarding NTSA road safety campaigns on seatbelt use and speed limits.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi imetolewa kuhusu kampeni za usalama barabarani za NTSA kuhusu matumizi ya mkanda wa usalama na mwendo.
Dholuo: Osegolo wach ma ng'ato nyalo ng'eyo e wi kampen mag NTSA mag rito ng'ato e yo e wi tiyo kod bandi mar ng'ado mtoka kod ng'ado mtoka mapiyo.
Somali: Warbixin rasmi ah ayaa la soo saaray oo ku saabsan ololaha badbaadada waddooyinka ee NTSA ee isticmaalka suunka iyo xadka xawaaraha.

English: Residents can access three key services: NTSA road safety campaigns on seatbelt use and speed limits, Huduma Namba registration under the national identity management system, and reporting cybercrime under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanaweza kupata huduma tatu muhimu: kampeni za usalama barabarani za NTSA kuhusu matumizi ya mkanda wa usalama na mwendo, usajili wa Huduma Namba chini ya mfumo wa kitaifa wa usimamizi wa utambulisho, na kuripoti uhalifu wa mtandaoni chini ya Sheria ya Matumizi Mabaya ya Kompyuta na Uhalifu wa Mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Jodak nyalo yudo kony adek madongo: Kampen mag NTSA mag rito yore mag tiyo kod ng'ado mtoka kod ng'ado ng'wech mapiyo, ndiko nying' Huduma Namba e bwo chenro mar rito ng'ato e piny, kod lando weche mag ketho mag mbui e bwo chik mar tiyo marach gi kompyuta kod ketho mag mbui.
Somali: Deganayaashu waxay heli karaan saddex adeeg oo muhiim ah: Ololayaasha badbaadada waddooyinka ee NTSA ee isticmaalka suunka iyo xadadka xawaaraha, diiwaangelinta Huduma Namba ee hoos timaada nidaamka maaraynta aqoonsiga qaranka, iyo ka warbixinta dembiyada internetka ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Si xun u Isticmaalka Kombiyuutarka iyo Dembiyada Internetka.

English: The county is running parallel initiatives: the Nyumba Kumi community policing initiative for neighbourhood security and reporting cybercrime under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act.
Kiswahili: Kaunti inaendesha mipango sambamba: mpango wa Nyumba Kumi wa ulinzi wa jamii kwa usalama wa mitaa na kuripoti uhalifu wa mtandaoni chini ya Sheria ya Matumizi Mabaya ya Kompyuta na Uhalifu wa Mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Kauntino timo chenro machalre: chenro mar rito jopolisi mag Nyumba Kumi mar rito alwora kod lando weche mag ketho mag mbui e bwo chik mar tiyo marach gi kompyuta kod ketho mag mbui.
Somali: Degmadu waxa ay waddaa qorshayaal is barbar socda: hindisaha booliiska beesha Nyumba Kumi ee amniga xaafadda iyo ka warbixinta dambiyada internetka ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Si xun u Isticmaalka Kombiyuutarka iyo Dembiyada Internetka.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in reporting cybercrime under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika kuripoti uhalifu wa mtandaoni chini ya Sheria ya Matumizi Mabaya ya Kompyuta na Uhalifu wa Mtandaoni.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopiny mondo okaw okang' mar keto ripot mag ketho mag mbui e bwo chik mar tiyo marach gi kompyuta kod ketho mag mbui.
Somali: Muwaadiniinta ayaa lagu booriyay inay ka qaybqaataan ka warbixinta dambiyada internetka ee hoos yimaada Xeerka Ku-takri-falka Kumbuyuutarka iyo Dembiyada Internetka.

English: In addition to the Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) crime-reporting hotline, residents can also benefit from NACADA's campaigns against drug and substance abuse among youth.
Kiswahili: Mbali na laini ya kuripoti uhalifu ya Idara ya Upelelezi wa Jinai (DCI), wakazi wanaweza pia kunufaika na kampeni za NACADA dhidi ya matumizi ya dawa za kulevya miongoni mwa vijana.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi namba ma ng'ato nyalo ng'adogo weche mag ketho (DCI), jodak bende nyalo yudo ber kuom kampen ma NACADA timo mar kwedo tiyo marach gi yath ma mero ji e kind joma tindo.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago Agaasinka Baarista Dambiyada (DCI) khadka warbixinta dembiyada, dadka deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale ka faa'iideysan kara ololayaasha NACADA ee ka dhanka ah maandooriyaha iyo ku xadgudubka muqaadaraadka ee dhalinyarada.

English: An awareness drive is underway to promote the National Disaster Operations Centre's flood and drought early-warning alerts.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya uhamasishaji inaendelea kukuza tahadhari za mapema za mafuriko na ukame kutoka Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Uendeshaji wa Maafa.
Dholuo: Kambi mar ng'eyo ji dhi nyime mondo oket puonj ma ng'ato nyalo ng'eyogo ng'ato ka ng'ato kuom pi ma pong'o piny kod oro.
Somali: Olole wacyigelineed ayaa socda si kor loogu qaado digniinaha hore ee fatahaadaha iyo abaaraha ee Xarunta Hawlaha Masiibooyinka Qaranka.

English: Use strong padlocks for gates and sheds - avoid cheap, easy-to-cut locks.
Kiswahili: Tumia kufuli imara kwa malango na vibanda - epuka kufuli za bei rahisi na rahisi kukata.
Dholuo: Ti gi yiende motegno e dhoudi kod ute mag joma ok nyal yieyo.
Somali: Isticmaal furayaasha adag ee albaabbada iyo qolalka - ka fogow furayaasha raqiis ah ee si fudud loo jaray.

English: PRWG urged police to prevent masked infiltrators during protests, maintain professional crowd control, and ensure accountability for misconduct.
Kiswahili: PRWG iliwasihi polisi kuzuia wavamizi waliovaa barakoa wakati wa maandamano, kudumisha udhibiti wa kitaalamu wa umati, na kuhakikisha uwajibikaji kwa utovu wa nidhamu.
Dholuo: PRWG ne ojiwo polise mondo ogeng' joma donjo e timbe mag wuondo, kendo mondo gichak rito oganda mar ji, kendo mondo gimi ji duto obed gi ketho kuom timbe maricho.
Somali: Ururka PRWG wuxuu booliiska ku booriyay inay ka hortagaan inay soo galaan mudaaharaadyada, inay xakameynayaan shaqaalaha, iyo inay hubiyaan inay mas'uul ka yihiin dhaqanka xun.

English: Reduce speeds near schools during opening and closing hours.
Kiswahili: Punguza kasi karibu na shule wakati wa saa za kufungua na kufunga.
Dholuo: Med dhi machiegni gi skul e seche mag yawo koda mag loko.
Somali: Waqtiga dugsiga furitaanka iyo dhamaadka ka yaree xawaaraha iskuulka.

English: Kenya's policy framework ensures coordinated disaster management. Understand your rights and government obligations.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa sera wa Kenya unahakikisha usimamizi wa maafa ulioratibiwa. Elewa haki zako na majukumu ya serikali.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya mar timo lokruok e weche mag siasa miyo ji bedo gi chenro maber mar rito masiche.
Somali: Qaab dhismeedka siyaasadda Kenya wuxuu hubiyaa in masiibooyinka la maareeyo si habsami leh.

English: During search and rescue operations, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa operesheni za utafutaji na uokoaji, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na milipuko ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: E kinde mag manyo kendo reso ji, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudorego mapiyo kapo ni tuoche moko owuok.
Somali: Inta lagu jiro hawlgallada goobidda iyo samatabbixinta, had iyo jeer gacanta ku hay xiriirrada degdegga ah haddii ay cudurro dillaacaan.

English: The National Disaster Operations Centre has issued an update on disease outbreak alerts.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Uendeshaji wa Maafa kimetoa taarifa kuhusu tahadhari za milipuko ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: Ofis mar piny mangima mar rito masira osegolo wach manyien kuom gik ma nyalo kelo tuoche.
Somali: Xarunta Hawlaha Masiibooyinka Qaranka ayaa soo saartay war cusub oo ku saabsan digniinaha dillaaca cudurrada.

English: A court verdict held a police sergeant accountable in a fatal shooting case, setting precedent for misconduct prosecutions.
Kiswahili: Uamuzi wa mahakama ulimfanya sajenti wa polisi kuwajibika katika kesi ya kupigwa risasi na kusababisha kifo, na kuweka mfano wa mashtaka ya utovu wa nidhamu.
Dholuo: Kot nong'ado bura ma nomiyo jatend polise odonjo e bura nikech ne oneg ng'ato ka ne onege. Mano nomiyo oter kesno e kot nikech timbe maricho.
Somali: Go'aanka maxkamaddu wuxuu ku baaqay nin booliis ah inuu xisaabtamo kiiska toogashada dhimashada, taasoo tusaale u ah dacwad-bixiyayaasha aan waxba galabsanayn.

English: Teach children safe road crossing techniques.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto mbinu salama za kuvuka barabara.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo yore ma ginyalo ng'adoe ndara.
Somali: Carruurta ku baro inay si nabad ah u gudbaan wadada.

English: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari na barua pepe zinazojifanya kuwa zinatoka benki zinazoomba uthibitishaji wa akaunti.
Dholuo: Tang' gi barupe ma nyiso ni gin mag bengi
Somali: Ka digtoonow emails-ka bangiga oo u sheega in la xaqiijiyay koontadaada.

English: Older adults need tailored evacuation plans. Identify caregivers and accessible shelters in advance.
Kiswahili: Wazee wanahitaji mipango maalum ya uokoaji. Tambua walezi na makazi yanayoweza kufikiwa mapema.
Dholuo: Joma hikgi ng'eny onego otim chenro mar wuok e utegi, kendo onego ging'e joma rito nyithindgi kod kuonde dak ma ginyalo dhiye chon.
Somali: Dadka qaangaarka ah waxay u baahan yihiin qorshe lagu wareejiyo dadka.

English: During disease outbreaks, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of lightning strikes.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa milipuko ya magonjwa, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na mapigo ya radi.
Dholuo: E kinde ma tuoche pong'o piny, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo kapo ni mil polo omako.
Somali: Inta uu cudurku dillaaco, had iyo jeer gacanta ku hay xiriirrada degdega ah haddii ay dhacdo in danab ku dhaco.

English: UN urges transparent investigations after protest fatalities.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa wahimiza uchunguzi wa wazi baada ya vifo vya waandamanaji.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje dwaro ni otim nonro e wi joma notho nikech akwede.
Somali: Qaramada Midoobay waxay ku boorineysaa in baaritaano cad loo sameeyo dhimashada dadka mudaaharaadayaasha ah.

English: Kenya hosts regional training to strengthen capacity in combating terrorism financing with participation from experts across Africa.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaandaa mafunzo ya kikanda ili kuimarisha uwezo katika kupambana na ufadhili wa ugaidi kwa kushirikisha wataalamu kote Afrika.
Dholuo: Kenya timo tiegruok e pinje mag Afrika mondo omed jiwo nyalo mar kedo gi pesa ma itiyogo e chulo tuke mag mahundu.
Somali: Kenya waxay leedahay tababar gobol ah oo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ka hortagga kharashka argagixisada iyada oo la kaashanayo khubarada Afrika oo dhan.

English: During mass gatherings, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of drought.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mikusanyiko mikubwa, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na ukame.
Dholuo: E kinde mag chokruok mag ji mang'eny, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo ka ng'ato otho.
Somali: Inta lagu jiro isu imaatinka dadweynaha, had iyo jeer gacanta ku hay xiriirrada degdega ah haddii ay dhacdo abaar.

English: KNCHR tells of citizen engagement programs boosting security and human rights awareness in Kisumu County
Kiswahili: KNCHR inasimulia kuhusu programu za ushirikishwaji wa raia zinazoimarisha usalama na uhamasishaji wa haki za binadamu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu
Dholuo: KNCHR wacho ni nitie chenro mag konyo ji mondo obed gi winjruok maber gi sirkal kod chike mag dhano e gweng' mar Kisumu
Somali: KCHCHR waxay ka hadleysaa barnaamijyo shukaansi ah oo xoojinaya amniga iyo wacyiga xuquuqda aadanaha ee Gobolka Kisumu

English: Be wary of strangers offering unsolicited help with ATMs or banking.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na wageni wanaotoa msaada usioombwa na ATM au benki.
Dholuo: Tang' gi joma ok ing'eyo ma nyalo konyi tiyo gi gige pesa kata gige bengi.
Somali: Ka digtoonow dadka aadan aqoon ee ku siinaya caawimaad aan la weydiin ATM ama bangi.

English: Children with disabilities face higher risks of abuse. Ensure inclusive education and accessible reporting mechanisms for their protection.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye ulemavu wanakabiliwa na hatari kubwa zaidi za unyanyasaji. Hakikisha elimu jumuishi na mifumo ya kuripoti inayopatikana kwa urahisi kwa ajili ya ulinzi wao.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma nigi midekre yudo pek mang'eny e kwedo timbe njore.
Somali: Carruurta naafada ah ayaa khatarta ugu weyn ee lagu xadgudbo.

English: Institutions must coordinate across sectors to provide effective, compassionate responses to survivors.
Kiswahili: Taasisi lazima ziratibu katika sekta mbalimbali ili kutoa majibu yenye ufanisi na huruma kwa waathirika.
Dholuo: Oganda onego oriw lwedo tije mopogore opogore mondo ojiw joma osekale masira
Somali: Hay'adaha waa inay isugu yimaadaan qaybaha kala duwan si ay uga jawaabaan dadka badbaaday.

English: Research farms need strict security. Use CCTV, controlled access, and patrols.
Kiswahili: Mashamba ya utafiti yanahitaji ulinzi mkali. Tumia CCTV, ufikiaji unaodhibitiwa, na doria.
Dholuo: Puothe mitime nonro mopogre dwaro arita
Somali: Beeraha cilmi baarista waxay u baahan yihiin nabadgelyo adag.

English: Research showing how police community collaboration contributed to crime reduction in Machakos Sub County
Kiswahili: Utafiti unaoonyesha jinsi ushirikiano wa jamii ya polisi ulivyochangia kupunguza uhalifu katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Machakos
Dholuo: Nonro manyiso kaka riwruok mar oganda mar polise nokonyo e dwoko piny mahundu e sub county mar Machakos
Somali: Daraasad muujineysa sida wada shaqeynta booliska ay gacan ka geysatay dhimista dambiyada Gobolka Macachakos

English: Contact the Kenya Red Cross for assistance during disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wasiliana na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya kwa msaada wakati wa milipuko ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: Tudri kod Red Cross mar piny Kenya mondo iyud kony e seche ma tuoche opong'o piny.
Somali: La xiriir Laanqayrta Cas ee Kenya si aad gargaar u hesho inta cudurku dillaaco.

English: During flooding emergencies, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa dharura za mafuriko, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na milipuko ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masira mag pi ma pong'o piny, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma nyalo konyi e lweti mondo kik tuoche ochop.
Somali: Inta lagu jiro xaaladaha degdegga ah ee daadadka, had iyo jeer gacanta ku hay xiriirrada degdega ah haddii ay cudurro dillaacaan.

English: Stay alert for updates on cybersecurity threats from official government channels.
Kiswahili: Kaa macho kwa taarifa kuhusu vitisho vya usalama wa mtandao kutoka njia rasmi za serikali.
Dholuo: Bed gi ritruok kuom weche ma nyasani ewi luoro mag mbui mawuok e chanel mag sirkal.
Somali: Ka digtoonow wixii ku soo kordha hanjabaadaha amniga internetka ee ka imaanaya kanaalada rasmiga ah ee dawladda.

English: In light of recent domestic violence cases, residents are reminded to follow workplace safety standards.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na visa vya hivi karibuni vya unyanyasaji wa nyumbani, wakazi wanakumbushwa kufuata viwango vya usalama mahali pa kazi.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi kes ma osetimore machiegni mag ng'anjo e ot, iparo ne jodak mondo giluw chike mag arita e kar tich.
Somali: Marka la eego kiisaskii rabshada qoyska ee dhawaan dhacay, dadka deegaanka waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay raacaan heerarka badbaadada goobta shaqada.

English: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
Kiswahili: "DCI inachunguza mpango bandia wa 'ruzuku ya vijana wanaoanza' unaosambazwa kwenye TikTok na Instagram. Hakuna mpango kama huo unaofadhiliwa na Serikali ya Kenya."
Dholuo: "DCI nono chenro mar miriambo ma yudore e TikTok kod Instagram. onge chenro ma kamano ma sirkal mar Kenya nigo mar chiwo pesa".
Somali: "DCI waxay baareysaa barnaamijyo been abuur ah oo loo yaqaan 'leprosy' oo lagu faafiyo TikTok iyo Instagram. Ma jiro barnaamij la mid ah oo ay maalgeliso Dowladda Kenya".

English: Authorities issued detailed Cyclone Hidaya safety guidance urging coastal residents to secure property and avoid non-essential travel.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka yalitoa mwongozo wa kina wa usalama wa Kimbunga Hidaya kikiwataka wakazi wa pwani kulinda mali na kuepuka usafiri usio wa lazima.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne ogolo weche matut e wi weche mag ritruok mag kodh yamo mag Hurricane Hidaya ka gikwayo jogweng' manie nam mondo orit mwandugi kendo gitang' gi wuoth maok ochuno.
Somali: Mas'uuliyiintu waxay bixiyeen tilmaamo faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan Hydaya oo u baahan dadka ku nool xeebta inay hanti helaan oo ay ka fogaadaan gaadiidka caadiga ah.

English: Stay informed on disease outbreak alerts and follow curfew regulations to keep your family safe.
Kiswahili: Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu tahadhari za milipuko ya magonjwa na ufuate kanuni za amri ya kutotoka nje kuweka familia yako salama.
Dholuo: Bed gi ng'eyo ewi lendo mag tuoche kendo luwo chike mag kafiu mondo orit joodu maber.
Somali: La soco digniinaha dillaaca cudurrada oo raac xeerarka bandowga si aad qoyskaaga u ilaaliso.

English: Report environmental violations and support community advocacy for natural resource protection.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ukiukwaji wa mazingira na uunge mkono utetezi wa jamii kwa ajili ya ulinzi wa maliasili.
Dholuo: Riw ripot kuom ketho alwora kendo riwo lwedo riwruok mar oganda ma kedo ne ritruok mar mwandu mag piny.
Somali: Warbixinta xadgudubyada deegaanka iyo taageerada difaaca bulshada ee ilaalinta kheyraadka dabiiciga ah.

English: Follow correct procedures when your vehicle breaks down.
Kiswahili: Fuata taratibu sahihi gari lako linapoharibika.
Dholuo: Tim gik makare sama mtoka okethore.
Somali: Marka baabuurkaagu burburiyo, u dhaqmaan si sax ah.

English: Many children drown in open water sources. Parents should supervise kids near pools, rivers, and wells.
Kiswahili: Watoto wengi huzama kwenye vyanzo vya maji vilivyo wazi. Wazazi wanapaswa kuwasimamia watoto karibu na madimbwi ya maji, mito, na visima.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mang'eny thoga e pi ma yudore e dho nam, kendo jonyuol onego orit nyithindgi machiegni gi yawo, aore, kod sokni.
Somali: Waalidiintu waxay u baahan yihiin inay carruurtooda ku ilaaliyaan meelaha ay ku yaalliin biyaha, webiyada iyo ceelasha.

English: Communities in flood-prone areas should prepare for lightning strikes this rainy season.
Kiswahili: Jamii katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na mafuriko zijiandae kwa mapigo ya radi msimu huu wa mvua.
Dholuo: Jodak ma ni e kuonde ma pi mang'eny nyalo pong'o piny onego oikre ne yamo mager mabiro e kinde kothni.
Somali: Bulshooyinka ku nool meelaha u nugul fatahaaduhu waa in ay u diyaar garoobaan hillaaca ku dhacaya xilli roobaadkan.

English: Communities facing building collapse risk should follow fire safety precautions issued by county disaster teams.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinazokabiliwa na hatari ya kuporomoka kwa jengo zinapaswa kufuata tahadhari za usalama wa moto zilizotolewa na timu za maafa za kaunti.
Dholuo: Oganda maromo gi luoro mar ketruok mar udi onego oluw okenge mag arita mag mach moketi gi riwruoge mag masira mag kaunti.
Somali: Bulshooyinka wajahaya khatarta burburka dhismaha waa inay raacaan taxaddarrada badbaadada dabka ee ay soo saaraan kooxaha musiibooyinka degmada.

English: Enhanced airport and public‑space security aims to protect visitors.
Kiswahili: Usalama ulioimarishwa wa viwanja vya ndege na anga za umma unalenga kuwalinda wageni.
Dholuo: Tego sirkal mar ndege kod sirkal mar alwora dwaro rito jowuoth.
Somali: Garoonka diyaaradaha iyo nabadgelyada diyaaradaha dadweynaha waxaa loogu talagalay inay ilaaliyaan dadka soo booqda.

English: During fire disasters, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of flooding.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa majanga ya moto, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na mafuriko.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masiche mag mach, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo ka pi opong'o piny.
Somali: Inta lagu jiro masiibooyinka dabka, had iyo jeer gacanta ku hay xiriirada degdega ah haddii ay daadad dhacaan.

English: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
Kiswahili: Usifanye maonyesho ya mali thamani kwa umma - weka kwa siri na salama.
Dholuo: Kik itim gima nyiso ni in gi nengo maduong' ne oganda - weka kwa siri na salama.
Somali: Urife bandhigay qiimaha dadweynaha - hay in sari iyo samaha.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."
Kiswahili: "Taarifa kwa umma: DCI imefunga kampuni ya ulaghai ya mali isiyohamishika inayofanya kazi kwa majina mengi huko Kiambu. Daima fanya utafutaji katika Wizara ya Ardhi."
Dholuo: DCI osemako jomatimo ohand lowo e yo morochore kiambu
Somali: "Ogaysiiska dadweynaha: DCI waxay xidhtay shirkad beero iyo guri been abuur ah oo ku shaqeysa magacyo kala duwan Kiambu. Had iyo jeer waxay baaritaan ku sameysaa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda".

English: IMLU report on community policing committees in Narumoru (serving Nyeri and Nyandarua region)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya IMLU kuhusu kamati za polisi jamii huko Narumoru (zinazohudumia mkoa wa Nyeri na Nyandarua)
Dholuo: Ripot mar IMLU e wi komiti mag polise e Narumoru (ma tiyo ne alwora mar Nyeri kod Nyandarua)
Somali: Warbixinta IMLU ee ku saabsan guddiyada maamulka bulshada ee Narumoru (xannaanada xayawaanka iyo xayawaanka)

English: Use crossing points and traffic lights where available.
Kiswahili: Tumia sehemu za kuingilia na taa za trafiki inapopatikana.
Dholuo: Ti gi ler mag ndara mondo kik gari nyoni
Somali: Isticmaal meelaha aad ka gudubto iyo nalalka baabuurta meesha aad joogtid.
